items.title: Awesome Analytics
items.content_text:
### SEO

*   [SenseGap](https://sensegap.com/) - Analytics for the AI crawlers and agents that visit a website (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, ChatGPT-User and others): checks bots against their published IP ranges or forward-confirmed reverse DNS where available and marks the rest unverified, shows which pages AI reads and how many visitors AI sends. The bot list and verification rules are open source. ([Demo](https://sensegap.com/demo), [Source Code (⭐0)](https://github.com/tudortotolici/sensegap)) `©` `SaaS`
*   [MessGEO](https://messgeo.com/) - AI search analytics that tracks how brands appear in ChatGPT, Gemini, Copilot, Google AI Mode and AI Overviews, with daily prompt tracking, share of voice and competitor comparison. `©` `SaaS`

### Privacy focused analytics

*   [Moxel](https://www.getmoxel.com/) - Cookieless web analytics for small sites and stores. Shows which form field or checkout step loses visitors, and what to change. `©` `SaaS`
*   [Skald](https://skaldanalytics.com/) - Web analytics built from your server's access log; separates people from AI assistants, crawlers and scanners. No cookies or tracking script. ([Source Code (⭐22)](https://github.com/spcaeo/skald)) `©` `Elastic-2.0` `Self-Hosted` `Python`

### Heatmap analytics

*   [DASHUND](https://dashund.link/?via=github) - Behavioral analytics for Figma prototypes: real paths (Sankey), click heatmaps, sessions and A/B tests before any code, with no tasks for testers. No IP stored, EU-hosted. Free plan. `©` `SaaS` `EU`

### Attribution tracking

*   [Appy](https://appy.to/) - Smart links and mobile SDKs for deep linking, install attribution, and in-app event and revenue tracking. SDK features require an Enterprise plan. `©` `SaaS`

### Social media analytics

*   [LurkAPI](https://lurkapi.com) - Social media data API: public profiles, follower counts, posts and comments from TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, X, Reddit and 11 more platforms as JSON. `©` `SaaS`

### Analytics dashboards

*   [MAD Designer](https://docs.everydayapps.com) - Native macOS and iOS ad-hoc SQL query builder, banded report layout designer, and headless Linux reporting engine supporting PostgreSQL, MySQL/MariaDB, SQL Server, and SQLite. ([Source Code (⭐2)](https://github.com/mthomason/MAD)) `MIT` `Objective-C`
*   [arcodash](https://www.arcodash.com/) - SQL dashboards that check their own numbers: connect a database, build dashboards, and get alerts on freshness, row count and null-rate checks. Unlimited seats. `©` `SaaS`
*   [Lookout](https://lookoutstats.com/) - Vercel Web Analytics and Speed Insights for all your Vercel projects on one board, with alerts, read-only share links, a REST API and an MCP server. Free for up to 100 projects. `©` `SaaS`

items.title: Awesome Postgres
items.content_text:
### Contents / Backups

*   [Portabase](https://portabase.io/) - Agent-based platform for logical PostgreSQL backups and restores with decentralized execution and centralized orchestration. ([Source Code (⭐1.9k)](https://github.com/Portabase/portabase))
*   [restoredrill (⭐114)](https://github.com/ahmadpiran/restoredrill) - CLI that restores your PostgreSQL backup into a disposable Docker container and verifies it actually works, producing a JSON report built for SOC 2 / ISO 27001 evidence.

### Contents / GUI

*   [Mongrel](https://www.visorcraft.com/postgresql) - Cross-platform PostgreSQL GUI with typed SQL, EXPLAIN (TEXT/JSON/XML/YAML), roles and grants, pgvector workflows, backups, and migrations (Commercial Software).
*   [SaturnSQL](https://saturnsql.com) - Browser-based collaborative SQL editor for teams, with scheduled query delivery to Google Sheets and Slack (Commercial Software).
*   [Sutido](https://sutido.com) - Windows desktop client covering PostgreSQL, MongoDB, SQL Server, Aerospike and ClickHouse in one window, with autocomplete from the live schema, SSH tunneling and server-side query cancellation (Commercial Software).

### Contents / Extensions

*   [pgmnemo (⭐8)](https://github.com/pgmnemo/pgmnemo) - Memory for AI coding agents as an extension: hybrid HNSW+BM25 recall, write-time provenance gates, and an outcome loop measured against a no-memory control (dataset published in-repo).

### Contents / Utilities

*   [pgrecon (⭐29)](https://github.com/Muzzammil242/pgrecon) - Offline Oracle-to-PostgreSQL migration assessment and schema conversion; parses PL/SQL with a real grammar, reports incompatibilities, estimates effort.
*   [Syncle](https://syncle.dev) - Web interface for syncing rows between Postgres and MySQL, SQLite, MongoDB or Redis, by backfill, polling, or logical replication.

### Contents / PaaS *(PostgreSQL as a Service)*

*   [Neon](https://neon.com) - Serverless Postgres that separates storage and compute. Branching, scale-to-zero, read replicas with no extra storage, instant restore (PITR), managed authentication, and a PostgREST-compatible Data API.

### Resources / Tutorials

*   [PostgreSQL Terminal Simulator](https://devops-daily.com/games/postgres-terminal-simulator) - Guided psql lessons in a simulated terminal in the browser: meta-commands, EXPLAIN, indexes and transactions. Free, no signup.

### File and file system handling

### File format converters

### Organizers and calendars

*   [chroncal (⭐236)](https://github.com/DouglasdeMoura/chroncal) - Terminal-first calendar, todo, and journal manager with iCalendar (RFC 5545) support and CalDAV sync - CLI+TUI, local SQLite storage.

### Screen recorder

### Utilities

items.title: Awesome Mqtt
items.content_text:
### Tools

*   [LibreDB Studio (⭐1.3k)](https://github.com/libredb/libredb-studio) - Open source web database IDE with a read-only MQTT 5.0 connection: browse a broker's live topic tree with retained messages and read topics, including Sparkplug B payloads.
*   [MQTTProbe (⭐41)](https://github.com/bluegrassiot/mqttprobe) - Cross platform MQTT diagnostic client for IIoT with live topic browsing, payload decoding across multiple formats, charting, built in emulators, and advanced Sparkplug B integration.
*   [TrailTransfer (⭐0)](https://github.com/RainerGewalt/trailtransfer) - MQTT-controlled rclone worker for edge file transfers with a local policy and a hash-chained, independently verifiable evidence journal.

items.content_text:
### Audio

*   [libsamplerate (⭐750)](https://github.com/libsndfile/libsamplerate) - An audio sample rate conversion library. \[BSD-2-Clause]

### CLI

*   [ansicolor-w32.c (⭐70)](https://github.com/mattn/ansicolor-w32.c) - ANSI escape sequence support for Windows console applications.

### Compression

*   [libzip (⭐1.1k)](https://github.com/nih-at/libzip) - A C library for reading, creating, and modifying zip archives.

### Concurrency

*   [libcuckoo (⭐1.8k)](https://github.com/efficient/libcuckoo) - A high-performance, concurrent hash table.

### Debug

*   [easy\_profiler (⭐2.4k)](https://github.com/yse/easy_profiler) - Lightweight profiler library for C++. \[MIT]
*   [Orbit (⭐4.3k)](https://github.com/google/orbit) - C/C++ performance profiler. \[BSD-2-Clause]

### Logging

*   [NanoLog (⭐3.4k)](https://github.com/PlatformLab/NanoLog) - An extremely performant nanosecond-scale logging system for C++.

### Machine Learning

*   [clDNN (⭐574)](https://github.com/intel/clDNN) - Compute library for deep neural networks.

### Math

*   [ampl/mp (⭐255)](https://github.com/ampl/mp) - An open-source library for mathematical programming.
*   [cvmlib (⭐8)](https://github.com/drnikolaev/cvmlib) - This C++ class library encapsulates concepts of vector and different matrices including square, band, symmetric and hermitian ones in Euclidean space of real and complex numbers. \[Boost]
*   [libbf](https://bellard.org/libbf/) - A C library for arbitrary-precision binary floating-point arithmetic.

### PDF

*   [wkhtmltopdf (⭐15k)](https://github.com/wkhtmltopdf/wkhtmltopdf) - Convert HTML to PDF using Qt WebKit. \[LGPL-3.0]

### Physics

*   [IAU SOFA (⭐3)](https://github.com/jacobwilliams/IAU_SOFA) - Standards of Fundamental Astronomy (SOFA) algorithms and procedures implementing standard models used in fundamental astronomy. \[[SOFA](https://www.iausofa.org/tandc.html)]

### Robotics

*   [Sophus (⭐2.5k)](https://github.com/strasdat/Sophus) - C++ implementation of Lie groups using Eigen.

### Serial Port

*   [hidapi (⭐2.5k)](https://github.com/signal11/hidapi) - A simple library for communicating with USB and Bluetooth HID devices.

### Virtual Machines

*   [vmir (⭐701)](https://github.com/andoma/vmir) - Virtual machine for a low-level intermediate representation. \[MIT]

items.title: Awesome Micropython
items.content_text:
### Communications / RFID

*   [micropython-uhf-module (⭐0)](https://github.com/HowManyOliversAreThere/micropython-uhf-module) - A MicroPython driver for the Tenhanyun TY928 UHF RFID embedded module.

### Communications / Serialization

*   [micropython-msgpackc (⭐2)](https://github.com/Tangerino/micropython-msgpackc) - Fast MessagePack in C, a drop-in replacement for umsgpack.

### Communications / Web

*   [MicroPyServer (⭐156)](https://github.com/troublegum/micropyserver) - A simple HTTP server for MicroPython projects.

### Display / HDMI

*   [anx7625 (⭐9)](https://github.com/dmazzella/anx7625) - MicroPython porting of video primitives for Portenta H7 via USBC (to HDMI adapter).

### Display / LCD Graphic

*   [MicroPython-Sharp-Memory-Display (⭐0)](https://github.com/peter-l5/MicroPython-Sharp-Memory-Display) - MicroPython driver for SHARP memory LCD displays.

### Display / Printer

*   [coffee-edition-kit (⭐0)](https://github.com/ierolsen/coffee-edition-kit) - Pico W firmware that pulls print jobs from GitHub over HTTPS and streams them to a network printer over IPP, for a nightly newspaper.

### Storage / Database

*   [ownSQL (⭐2)](https://github.com/TimonW-Dev/ownSQL) - A MySQL database driver for MicroPython, supporting MySQL Server 8.x and 9.x.

### Frameworks / SRAM

*   [OreoOS (⭐9)](https://github.com/elixpo/oreo) - Operating system for an open-hardware ESP32-S3 conference badge, with an app SDK, on-device app store, OTA updates and native video playback.
*   [openbricks (⭐7)](https://github.com/1e0ng/openbricks) - Pybricks-style robotics firmware for ESP32: 1 kHz native drivebase control, serial bus servos, IMU gyro heading, line sensors, plus a MuJoCo simulator.

### Tools / On Host

*   [thonny-ai (⭐0)](https://github.com/AstroQuestStudio/thonny-ai) - Thonny plugin and MCP server that lets AI assistants run code, monitor long-running programs and sync projects on MicroPython boards, visibly and with optional approval.

items.title: Collective Ai Tools
items.content_text:
### Audio & Speech

*   [Transcribe Video: To The Text](https://video2text.ttt.so/) - iPhone app that transcribes video and audio files, YouTube or Vimeo links and live voice recordings, with speaker labels, a one-tap summary and TXT/DOCX export. `#freemium` `#transcription`

### Developer Tools

*   [Browser Agent Blueprint (⭐1)](https://github.com/LydiaTools/browser-agent-blueprint) - Open-source browser agent prompt modules and synthetic recovery examples for uncertain actions. `#free` `#opensource`
*   [Keenable](https://keenable.ai) - Independent web search index for AI agents: search and page fetch over API, CLI and MCP (`https://api.keenable.ai/mcp`), with 100K free requests a month and keyless public endpoints. `#freemium` `#api` `#mcp`
*   [Model Salt](https://modelsalt.com/) - Open source MCP server with one tool: before a creative task the model gets a few choices drawn from atmospheric and quantum noise, so one prompt gives different answers that still do what was asked. `#free` `#opensource` `#mcp`
*   [SoloPup Memory (⭐1)](https://github.com/OakcoderX/solopup-memory) - Native DeepSeek Harness text-memory beta with source references, project scope and correction history; requires Node >=24.9 and DSH >=0.2.1-rc.0 <0.3.0, and configured model APIs may charge. `#opensource` `#memory`
*   [sqlite-graph-memory (⭐14)](https://github.com/tonydzi/sqlite-graph-memory) - MCP server and CLI that gives coding agents recall over a folder of markdown notes, following `[[wikilinks]]` as a graph in one SQLite file. `#opensource` `#free` `#mcp`
*   [Teapot Router](https://teapotrouter.com) - Team API gateway for GPT and Claude Code: one shared token pool, per-request metering (model, tokens, cache hits, exact cost), a public price book with no login, and org-level key management. `#paid`
*   [UberLLM](https://uberllm.dev/) - One OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible API key for GPT, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek and uncensored text models plus image, video, music and speech models, billed at what each provider charged. `#paid` `#api` `#llm`

### E-Commerce

*   [Etsy Search & Shop Sales MCP (⭐3)](https://github.com/GeminiGeorge22/etsy-sales-mcp) - MCP server that gives AI assistants Etsy search results by keyword, marketplace and category plus daily sales counts and growth for any Etsy shop; runs on your own Apify token. `#opensource` `#mcp`
*   [EverAlice AI](https://everalice.studio/) - All-in-one AI studio for Etsy and digital-product sellers: turns one artwork or idea into listing copy and SEO tags for 25 marketplaces, studio mockups, print-ready files, listing videos, a launch marketing pack and a customer delivery ZIP, with bulk runs of up to 100 products. `#freemium`

### Finance

*   [DisconfirmAI](https://disconfirmai.com/en) - AI investment research and reading tool that looks for evidence against your thesis before you commit, with daily source reading, filings and earnings research, condition-based change alerts and a personal investment framework. `#freemium` `#research`

### Image Classification

*   [Nature GO](https://naturego.app/identify-animal-by-photo/) - Android app that suggests the species of a bird, insect, mammal or plant from an 8-second video filmed in the app, shows the visible evidence, and can also name a gallery photo. `#freemium`

### Image Editing

*   [Clarpex AI](https://clarpex.ai/) - Free online AI photo fixer to unblur, restore old photos, colorize black and white photos, remove glare and upscale to 4K or 8K, with daily free credits and no sign-up. `#freemium` `#photo`

### Image Generator

*   [MakeImg](https://makeimg.ai/) - AI photo generator that turns a text prompt or reference photo into a new image, with 11 models and free daily credits. `#freemium` `#image`
*   [QuestStudio](https://queststudio.io/) - Generate and edit images, then continue related video, voice, and music workflows in a connected creative studio. `#paid` `#design`

### Marketing

*   [Google Ads Transparency MCP (⭐0)](https://github.com/GeminiGeorge22/google-ads-transparency-mcp) - MCP server that gives AI assistants a competitor's Google ads from the Google Ads Transparency Center: new, running or stopped, with first and last shown dates; runs on your own Apify token. `#opensource` `#mcp`

### Music

*   [Spotify Play Count MCP (⭐0)](https://github.com/GeminiGeorge22/spotify-play-count-mcp) - MCP server that gives AI assistants Spotify play counts for any track, album, artist or playlist, plus artist monthly listeners and followers; runs on your own Apify token. `#opensource` `#mcp`

### Presentation

*   [EditableImage](https://editableimage.com/) - Turns a slide screenshot into an editable PowerPoint with real text boxes over a rebuilt background; also converts diagram pictures to draw\.io and flat artwork to layered PSD. Paid credit packs with a one-time free trial of 10 credits for two conversions on signup; no ongoing free tier. `#paid`

### Productivity

*   [AUTOMATER.ai](https://automater.ai/) - Tray app that keeps track of every AI coding agent you run: a searchable library of past sessions, a flag when an agent is waiting on you, and usage across 9 providers. `#freemium`
*   [Plainer](https://plainer.app/) - Workspace for notes and files with a planner view, timeboxing and an AI assistant whose changes you can undo. `#freemium`

### Real Estate

*   [RoomLab.app](https://roomlab.app/) - AI virtual staging, decluttering, restyling and walkthrough videos from room photos `#freemium`

### SEO

*   [AgentSEO](https://www.agentseo.dev/) - SEO API and MCP tools for keyword research, SERP analysis, rank tracking, and AI search visibility. New accounts receive 100 one-time live credits, then ongoing use requires a paid plan. `#paid` `#seo` `#mcp`

### Sales

*   [Chuttamalle Dance AI](https://trychuttamalle.app/) - Authorized portrait to \~15s generative dance clip; packs from $8.88. `#paid`

*   [JeanPhilAI](https://jeanphilai.cc/) - One photo to \~12-15s blond bob + moustache clip; packs from $8.88. `#paid`

*   [RemixMeme](https://remixmeme.com/) - AI meme video generator from photos with dance, pet and funny templates. `#paid`

### Writing

### Automation

*   [BuzzBlender Kiosk Editor](https://kiosk.buzzblender.com/) - No-code kiosk interface builder for creating button-based experiences with video, images and text, with preview and standalone HTML export.

*   [BESSER Agentic Framework (⭐71)](https://github.com/BESSER-PEARL/BESSER-Agentic-Framework) - Design and implement agents and chatbots in Python.

items.title: Magictools
items.content_text:
### Graphics / Assets/Placeholders

*   :money\_with\_wings: [Gridwright Studio](https://gridwright.store/) - Subscription library of pixel-art game asset packs (tilesets, characters, UI, icons, effects, isometric, music and SFX) for any engine, many with Godot scenes and Tiled tilesets. Free samples with a free account. Drawn in code with AI-assisted tools.
*   :free: [Minecraft Pixel Art](https://minecraft-pixel-art.com/editor/blueprint) - Browser image-to-Minecraft block blueprints with material lists, PNG plans and Java structure NBT export; no account required.

### Graphics / Spritesheet Tools

*   :free: [SpriteCanvas Sprite Sheet Tools](https://spritecanvas.com/tools/) - Free browser tools that slice a sprite sheet into frames, pack images into a sheet, convert GIFs to sheets and back, and turn MP4/WebM clips into sheets with a JSON atlas. Files stay on your device; no account needed.

### Graphics / Texture Tools

*   :money\_with\_wings: [DDS Tools](https://ddstools.com/) - Fast DDS texture converter and viewer for game modders that runs in the browser. Converts PNG, JPG, TGA and WebP to BC1, BC3, BC5 or BC7 DDS and DDS back to PNG. Files are processed locally, without uploading to a server.
*   :money\_with\_wings: [GameShipKit Sprite Normal Map](https://gameshipkit.com/tools/sprite-normal-map/) - Generate normal maps from 2D sprites for lit 2D scenes.

### Graphics / Character Generators

*   :money\_with\_wings: [GameShipKit 2D Character Rigging](https://gameshipkit.com/tools/character-rigging/) - Rig a 2D character in the browser and export idle, walk and attack animations as sprite sheets.

### Graphics / Tile/Level Editors

*   :money\_with\_wings: [GameShipKit Autotile Generator](https://gameshipkit.com/tools/autotile-generator/) - Make blob and RPG Maker style autotiles from two textures, with Godot 4 and Tiled tilesets.
*   :money\_with\_wings: [GameShipKit Map Generator](https://gameshipkit.com/tools/map-generator/) - Seeded dungeon, cave and island maps, exported as PNG, Tiled JSON and CSV.
*   :free: [SimplePixelArt Tileset Editor](https://simplepixelart.com/tilesets/editor) - Draw auto-tile tilesets in the browser and export them as Godot TileSet (.tres) and Tiled (.tsx) files.

### Graphics / Animation

*   :money\_with\_wings: [SlotVFX](https://slotvfx.com/) - Desktop editor for particles and game VFX with Spine support. Free to use; exports for Pixi, Phaser, Cocos Creator and WebGL2 need a paid plan.

### Graphics / Vector/Image Editor

*   :free: [Pic2Vector](https://pic2vector.com/) - Free in-browser PNG/JPG/WebP to layered SVG tracer for game icons and UI art. Runs locally with WebAssembly (vtracer); no upload, no account, watermark-free export.
*   :free: [SimplePixelArt](https://simplepixelart.com/) - Free browser pixel art editor with layers, animation frames and palettes; exports PNG, GIF and sprite sheets with Aseprite-style frame tags for game engines.

### Graphics / Modeling

*   :money\_with\_wings: [Unity Asset Exporter](https://extractunitypackage.com) - Open .unitypackage files in the browser without Unity and export models as textured GLB.

### AI / Voxel Editors

*   :money\_with\_wings: [Flockbay](https://flockbay.com/?utm_source=magictools\&utm_medium=directory\&utm_campaign=listing) - Free AI game maker built on Godot: a desktop app where an AI agent builds and playtests a Godot 4 project on your disk, on free hosted AI, your own Claude or ChatGPT account, or your own agent over MCP. Optional paid plans add hosted AI usage.
*   :free: [QuickMatch](https://quickmatch.si) - Free comparison of AI tools for making games and AI agent skills for game dev. Prices, free tiers and commercial-use terms come from each vendor's own page with the date checked, plus a matcher that suggests tools from a few questions.
*   :money\_with\_wings: [SpriteCanvas](https://spritecanvas.com/) - AI sprite animation generator for 2D games: make a character from text or an image, animate idle, walk, run, jump and attack moves, and export transparent PNG sprite sheets with a JSON atlas for Phaser, PixiJS and Godot. Free daily credits.
*   :money\_with\_wings: [Ziva.sh](https://ziva.sh/) - AI agent plugin inside the Godot editor that edits scenes and scripts, reads editor errors, playtests your game and generates game sound effects from a prompt. On its Pro and Ultra plans, Devlog records your game runs while you build and turns them into 10-15 second vertical devlog videos with captions.

### Programming Languages Support / Diagnostics

*   [alessandropietrobelli/dotnet-tree.nvim (⭐3)](https://github.com/alessandropietrobelli/dotnet-tree.nvim) - A `.NET` solution explorer as a neo-tree source, showing solution folders, projects, project references and package versions, with support for many `dotnet` actions.

*   [ywsrock/nvim-md-preview (⭐2)](https://github.com/ywsrock/nvim-md-preview) - Markdown preview in your browser with two-way cursor sync, Mermaid and KaTeX support, and PDF/DOCX/HTML/EPUB export.

*   [alexcloudstar/cheatsheet.nvim (⭐1)](https://github.com/alexcloudstar/cheatsheet.nvim) - Telescope cheatsheet for your keybindings; look up a key by task or keyword and add your own keys.

*   [LongYinStudio/suda.nvim (⭐3)](https://github.com/LongYinStudio/suda.nvim) - Transparent, "sudo-like" privilege elevation without virtual URI hacks.

### Formatting / Folding

*   [javanoo6/intellij-formatter.nvim (⭐1)](https://github.com/javanoo6/intellij-formatter.nvim) - IntelliJ-powered formatting through conform.nvim, with EditorConfig support, Java import cleanup, and a reusable daemon.

*   [LFSCamargo/nvim.setup (⭐1)](https://github.com/LFSCamargo/nvim.setup) - Portable config with a file tree, editor tabs, and independent AI CLI chats in one window.

items.title: Awesome Healthcare
items.content_text:
### Contents / EHR

*   [Akello (⭐42)](https://github.com/akello-io/akello) - Integrated Mental Health Infrastructure
*   [Beda EMR (⭐132)](https://github.com/beda-software/fhir-emr) - EMR built natively on FHIR.
*   [BHIMA (⭐234)](https://github.com/third-culture-software/bhima) - Hospital information and accounting system for rural hospitals.
*   [CARE (⭐419)](https://github.com/ohcnetwork/care) - Digital public good for hospital administration and decentralized patient care.
*   [FerroEHR (⭐85)](https://github.com/FerroHEALTH/FerroEHR) - openEHR Clinical Data Repository written in Rust, with ITS-REST and AQL support on PostgreSQL.
*   [GitEHR (⭐6)](https://github.com/gitehr/gitehr) - Patient-owned, self-hostable EHR stored as plain-text files in a Git repository. Append-only journal, immutable documents, offline-first, no database.
*   [HasteHealth (⭐85)](https://github.com/HasteHealth/HasteHealth) - Scalable FHIR server and clinical data repository.
*   [ICTHospital (⭐115)](https://github.com/ictinnovations/ICTHospital) - Hospital management software with built-in unified communications, built on Laravel.
*   [Marley (⭐555)](https://github.com/earthians/marley) - Health information system built on the Frappe framework.
*   [Open Hospital (⭐638)](https://github.com/informatici/openhospital) - Electronic Medical Record software for underprivileged rural hospitals.

### Contents / Scribe

*   [Phlox (⭐110)](https://github.com/bloodworks-io/phlox) - Open source (MIT), self-hosted AI medical scribe with realtime note drafting, RAG, and MCP-extensible agents; runs as a desktop app or Docker image.

### Contents / Imaging

*   [Cornerstone3D (⭐1.2k)](https://github.com/cornerstonejs/cornerstone3D) - JavaScript libraries for building web-based medical imaging platforms.
*   [dcm2niix (⭐1.2k)](https://github.com/rordenlab/dcm2niix) - DICOM to NIfTI converter.
*   [highdicom (⭐241)](https://github.com/ImagingDataCommons/highdicom) - High-level DICOM abstractions for Python, including segmentations, structured reports and annotations.
*   [Horos (⭐643)](https://github.com/horosproject/horos) - Medical image viewer.
*   [MedPy (⭐623)](https://github.com/loli/medpy) - Python library for medical image processing, supporting DICOM and NIfTI formats with tools for segmentation, filtering, and feature extraction.
*   [mercure (⭐104)](https://github.com/mercure-imaging/mercure) - DICOM orchestrator for routing and processing imaging studies.
*   [MONAI Label (⭐908)](https://github.com/Project-MONAI/MONAILabel) - AI-assisted image labeling tool that works with 3D Slicer and OHIF.
*   [PyMedPhys (⭐368)](https://github.com/pymedphys/pymedphys) - Community library for medical physics.
*   [QuPath (⭐1.5k)](https://github.com/qupath/qupath) - Bioimage analysis and whole slide image analysis for digital pathology.
*   [SlicerDMRI (⭐86)](https://github.com/SlicerDMRI/SlicerDMRI) - Extension for 3D Slicer focused on diffusion MRI analysis and visualization, supporting neuroscience research.
*   [Weasis (⭐1.4k)](https://github.com/nroduit/Weasis) - Standalone and web-based DICOM viewer.

### Contents / Dental

*   [DentalPin (⭐110)](https://github.com/martinezsalmeron/dentalpin) - Dental practice management with an AI agent that runs real operations.

### Contents / Laboratory

*   [MISO (⭐316)](https://github.com/miso-lims/miso-lims) - Laboratory information management system for NGS sequencing centres.

### Contents / Frameworks

*   [CHT](https://communityhealthtoolkit.org/) - Community Health Toolkit - set of Open Source tools that support community healthcare
*   [HAPI FHIR JPA Server Starter (⭐544)](https://github.com/hapifhir/hapi-fhir-jpaserver-starter) - Ready-to-deploy FHIR server built on HAPI FHIR.
*   [Helios FHIR Server (⭐57)](https://github.com/HeliosSoftware/hfs) - FHIR server written in Rust, optimized for clinical analytics workloads.
*   [Opal (⭐288)](https://github.com/openhealthcare/opal) - Framework for building clinical applications.
*   [Spezi (⭐261)](https://github.com/StanfordSpezi/Spezi) - Stanford framework for building interoperable digital health apps on Apple platforms.

### Contents / Libraries

*   [dcmjs (⭐356)](https://github.com/dcmjs-org/dcmjs) - JavaScript implementation of DICOM manipulation.
*   [deid (⭐182)](https://github.com/pydicom/deid) - De-identification of DICOM images in Python.
*   [dicom-rs (⭐570)](https://github.com/Enet4/dicom-rs) - Rust implementation of the DICOM standard.
*   [fhir.resources (⭐543)](https://github.com/nazrulworld/fhir.resources) - Pydantic-based FHIR resource models for Python.
*   [fhir-py (⭐218)](https://github.com/beda-software/fhir-py) - Async and sync FHIR client for Python.
*   [HealthChain (⭐230)](https://github.com/healthchainai/HealthChain) - Python SDK for building healthcare AI applications with FHIR tools and real-time EHR connectivity.
*   [MITK](https://www.mitk.org/) - The Medical Imaging Interaction Toolkit.
*   [nHapi (⭐313)](https://github.com/nHapiNET/nHapi) - .NET port of the HAPI HL7 v2 library.
*   [nhs-number (⭐6)](https://github.com/wardle/nhs-number) - A Clojure/Script library providing validation, formatting and generation of UK NHS Numbers
*   [nhs-number (⭐14)](https://github.com/uk-fci/nhs-number) - Python package to provide utilities for NHS Numbers, including validity checks, normalisation, and generation.
*   [Pydicom (⭐2.2k)](https://github.com/pydicom/pydicom) - Pure Python package for working with DICOM files, enabling reading, writing, and manipulation of medical imaging data.
*   [sct (⭐32)](https://github.com/pacharanero/sct) - File-based SNOMED-CT toolset built in Rust.
*   [SMART on FHIR JavaScript client (⭐355)](https://github.com/smart-on-fhir/client-js) - JavaScript client for SMART on FHIR apps.

### Contents / Applications

*   [AirwayLab (⭐45)](https://github.com/airwaylab-app/airwaylab) - Browser-based airway analysis dashboard for PAP therapy users with flow limitation scoring, breathing pattern analysis, and oximetry metrics.
*   [CommCare HQ (⭐525)](https://github.com/dimagi/commcare-hq) - Server for CommCare, a mobile data collection platform for frontline health workers.
*   [OpenSRP FHIR Core (⭐70)](https://github.com/opensrp/fhircore) - Offline-capable Android app for community health workers, built on the Android FHIR SDK.
*   [RCPCH Digital Growth Charts](https://growth.rcpch.ac.uk) - Open source Digital Growth Charts platform with API, CLI, Python package, React chart components.
*   [SORMAS (⭐334)](https://github.com/SORMAS-Foundation/SORMAS-Project) - Surveillance, outbreak response management and analysis system.

### Contents / PHR

*   [AndroidAPS (⭐1.2k)](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS) - Open source automated insulin delivery system for Android.
*   [Loop (⭐1.8k)](https://github.com/LoopKit/Loop) - Automated insulin delivery app for iOS.
*   [Nightscout (⭐2.9k)](https://github.com/nightscout/cgm-remote-monitor) - Web monitor for continuous glucose monitor data.
*   [OpenHealth (⭐4k)](https://github.com/OpenHealthForAll/open-health) - Privacy-first AI health assistant that interprets personal health data (blood tests, checkups, family history, symptoms) with local LLM support via Ollama.
*   [Trio (⭐419)](https://github.com/nightscout/Trio) - Automated insulin delivery system for iOS based on the OpenAPS algorithm.
*   [xDrip+ (⭐1.8k)](https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip) - Android app for collecting and displaying continuous glucose monitor data.

### Contents / Research

*   [admiral (⭐324)](https://github.com/pharmaverse/admiral) - R package from pharmaverse for creating ADaM clinical trial datasets.

items.title: Awesome Vue
items.content_text:
### Resources / External Resources

*   [FrontendAtlas Vue Interview Questions](https://frontendatlas.com/vue/interview-questions) - Vue interview questions with explained answers and runnable examples; free to read, some coding exercises are paid.

### Projects Using Vue.js / Open Source

*   [Oxynote (⭐480)](https://github.com/oxynote/oxynote) - Self-hosted collaborative documentation built with Nuxt 4, Tiptap and Yjs: live Prometheus charts as editor blocks, draft reviews with visual diffs, and an Electron desktop build.
*   [EdgeChat (⭐1.4k)](https://github.com/aozorae/Edgechat) - Open-source team chat built with Vue 3, Vite, and Cloudflare Workers, with group and direct messages, Telegram bridging, file sharing, and WebRTC voice calls.

### Projects Using Vue.js / Commercial Products

*   [Beekeeper Studio](https://www.beekeeperstudio.io) - Cross-platform SQL editor and database client built with Vue.js and Electron, with a free open-source Community Edition.

### Projects Using Vue.js / Apps/Websites

*   [A11yKit](https://a11ykit.site) - 15 free, client-side web accessibility and WCAG 2.2 testing tools with zero code uploads.
*   [Remove Audio Tools](https://remove-audio.com/tools) - Over 30 free browser tools for video and audio (convert, compress, extract MP3, make GIFs, separate voice and music with AI) that process files on the device with FFmpeg.wasm and WebGPU. Built with Nuxt and Vue.

### Components & Libraries / Frameworks

*   [OpenVue (⭐421)](https://github.com/openvi-foundation/openvue) - MIT-licensed Vue 3 UI component library with a complete set of themable components, forked from PrimeVue 4.5.5.

### Components & Libraries / UI Components

*   [TradeCanvas (⭐28)](https://github.com/bonguynvan/tradecanvas) - Vue 3 component for trading charts: candlesticks to Renko, 111 indicators, drawing tools and live exchange feeds.
*   [File Viewer (⭐2.6k)](https://github.com/flyfish-dev/file-viewer) - Vue 3 file-preview component with lazy renderer presets covering 275 registered extensions, including experimental formats, across Office, PDF, CAD, 3D models, and archives.
*   [kritzel (⭐5)](https://github.com/kasual1/kritzel) - Infinite canvas component library for Vue.

### Components & Libraries / UI Utilities

*   [Formhaus (⭐8)](https://github.com/formhaus-dev/formhaus) - Forms from one JSON definition for Vue and React.

### Components & Libraries / Utilities

*   [Lingui](https://lingui.dev/tutorials/vue) - Internationalization for Vue 3. Write messages in plain language right in your templates, and Lingui takes care of the rest.
*   [vue-qs (⭐25)](https://github.com/iamsomraj/vue-qs) - Type-safe URL query state for Vue 3 and Nuxt, a port of nuqs. Writable refs synced with the search params, with typed parsers, batching and throttling.

### Components & Libraries / Dev Tools

*   [vue-why-render (⭐12)](https://github.com/dadashi44/vue-why-render) - shows why Vue 3 components re-render: highlights renders on the page and names the cause (props, state, Pinia stores, route changes, computeds), with a panel and a Nuxt module.

items.title: Awesome Web Security
items.content_text:
### Fingerprint

*   [Passive OS Fingerprinting: TCP Fingerprint, p0f and JA4T](https://packet.guru/blog/passive-os-fingerprinting) - How the first TCP SYN gives away the operating system family, why a proxy shows up as a mismatch with the OS the browser reports, and how p0f and JA4T record the same packet. Written by [packet.guru](https://packet.guru/).

### JWT

*   [How to revoke a JWT, from a system that does it](https://easinvy.com/notes/revoke-a-jwt) - A per-user revocation cut-off from a production multi-tenant app: why it compares against `auth_time` rather than `iat`, the whole-seconds rounding bug it shipped with, and the routes that trusted the token. Written by [Ridam Agrawal](https://ridamagrawal.com).

### SSRF

*   [Instance Metadata Abuse](https://ransomleak.com/exercises/instance-metadata-abuse/) - Shows how a server-side request forgery bug becomes cloud credential theft through the instance metadata service, and why requiring IMDSv2 session tokens with a response hop limit in the instance configuration closes the whole class of forging bugs rather than one code path, by [RansomLeak](https://ransomleak.com/).

### Scanning / Sub Domain Enumeration

*   [ONUS (⭐12)](https://github.com/maverickaayush/ONUS) - Web vulnerability assessment platform that orchestrates multiple scanners, applies deterministic CVSS v3.1 scoring, and provides AI-assisted vulnerability analysis and remediation guidance.
*   [Crossfyre Toolchain (⭐256)](https://github.com/clickswave/crossfyre-toolchain) - Recon and vulnerability scanning engines in Rust for subdomains, ports, content discovery, fingerprinting, injection testing and nuclei-style templates, with one CLI and newline-delimited JSON output by [@clickswave](https://github.com/clickswave).

### Decompiler / Server-Side Request Forgery

*   [Wakaru (⭐1.1k)](https://github.com/pionxzh/wakaru) - JavaScript decompiler that splits production bundles from webpack, esbuild, Browserify, and Metro into modules and turns minified and transpiled code back into readable JavaScript, without executing it, by [@pionxzh](https://github.com/pionxzh).

items.title: Awesome Privacy
items.content_text:
### Medical health / Apps and services

*   **[MedTimer (⭐648)](https://github.com/Futsch1/medTimer)** - Medication reminder that keeps all data on the device and has no internet permission. <sub>Android · MIT · [F-Droid](https://f-droid.org/packages/com.futsch1.medtimer/)</sub>

### Video and Audio Conferencing / Desktop

*   **WhatsApp**: in 2021 Ireland fined it €225 million for not properly explaining what data it shares with Facebook. <sub>[ToS;DR](https://tosdr.org/en/service/198) · [Source](https://www.dataprotection.ie/en/news-media/press-releases/data-protection-commission-announces-decision-whatsapp-inquiry)</sub>
*   **Zoom**: paid $85 million in 2021 to settle claims it shared user data with Facebook, Google and LinkedIn. <sub>[ToS;DR](https://tosdr.org/en/service/2198) · [Source](https://www.cnbc.com/2021/08/01/zoom-reaches-85-million-settlement-over-user-privacy-and-hacker-zoombombing.html)</sub>
*   **[BigBlueButton](https://bigbluebutton.org/)** - Self-hosted web conferencing built for online classes, with whiteboard, breakout rooms and recordings. `⚠️ website trackers` <sub>self-host · LGPL-3.0</sub>
*   **[Briefing](https://brie.fi/ng)** - Group video chat in the browser over direct WebRTC connections, with no account. <sub>self-host · AGPL-3.0</sub>
*   **[Chitchatter](https://chitchatter.im/)** - Serverless, ephemeral peer-to-peer chat with audio, video, screen and file sharing. <sub>GPL-2.0</sub>
*   **[Jami](https://jami.net/)** - Peer-to-peer audio and video calls and chat with no central servers or account needed. <sub>GPL-3.0 · [F-Droid](https://f-droid.org/packages/cx.ring/)</sub>
*   **[Jitsi Meet](https://jitsi.org/jitsi-meet/)** - Video conferencing you can self-host; the official instance requires you to log in. <sub>self-host · Apache-2.0 · [F-Droid](https://f-droid.org/packages/org.jitsi.meet/) (Play Store version has trackers)</sub>
*   **[MiroTalk P2P](https://p2p.mirotalk.com/)** - Browser-based peer-to-peer video calls up to 4K, with nothing to install. <sub>AGPL-3.0</sub>
*   **[Mumble](https://www.mumble.info/)** - Low-latency voice chat with encrypted connections, on servers you can run yourself. <sub>self-host</sub>

### Instant Messaging

*   **Facebook Messenger**: chats have been encrypted since 2023, but Meta still sees who you message, when, and who your contacts are. <sub>[ToS;DR](https://tosdr.org/en/service/182) · [Exodus](https://reports.exodus-privacy.eu.org/en/reports/com.facebook.orca/latest/) · [Source](https://www.eff.org/deeplinks/2023/12/meta-announces-end-end-encryption-default-messenger)</sub>

### Instagram / Desktop

*   **Instagram**: Ireland fined Meta €405 million in 2022 for exposing children's emails and phone numbers on Instagram. <sub>[ToS;DR](https://tosdr.org/en/service/219) · [Source](https://www.dataprotection.ie/en/news-media/press-releases/data-protection-commission-announces-decision-instagram-inquiry)</sub>
*   **[Pixelfed](https://pixelfed.org/)** - Federated photo sharing with posts, stories and a chronological feed, without ads. <sub>ActivityPub · AGPL-3.0</sub>

*   **[Universal Android Debloater Next Generation (⭐9.7k)](https://github.com/Universal-Debloater-Alliance/universal-android-debloater-next-generation)** - Desktop app that removes preinstalled bloatware from Android phones over ADB, no root needed. <sub>Desktop · GPL-3.0</sub>

### Android Dialer / Plugins for Minecraft

*   **[Fossify Phone](https://www.fossify.org/apps/phone/)** - Phone app with a phonebook, number blocking and multi-SIM support, part of the Fossify fork of Simple Mobile Tools. <sub>Android · GPL-3.0 · [F-Droid](https://f-droid.org/packages/org.fossify.phone/)</sub>

### Android File Manager / Plugins for Minecraft

*   **[Amaze File Manager (⭐6.5k)](https://github.com/TeamAmaze/AmazeFileManager)** - Material Design file manager with root access and a built-in FTP server. <sub>Android · GPL-3.0 · [F-Droid](https://f-droid.org/packages/com.amaze.filemanager/)</sub>
*   **[Fossify File Manager](https://www.fossify.org/apps/file-manager/)** - File manager with no ads or tracking that works without internet access. <sub>Android · GPL-3.0 · [F-Droid](https://f-droid.org/packages/org.fossify.filemanager/)</sub>
*   **[Ghost Commander](https://f-droid.org/packages/com.ghostsq.commander/)** - Dual-panel file manager. <sub>Android · [F-Droid](https://f-droid.org/packages/com.ghostsq.commander/)</sub>
*   **[Material Files (⭐9.4k)](https://github.com/zhanghai/MaterialFiles)** - Material Design file manager with root, archive, FTP, SFTP, SMB and WebDAV support. <sub>Android · GPL-3.0 · [F-Droid](https://f-droid.org/packages/me.zhanghai.android.files/)</sub>

### Android Keyboard / Plugins for Minecraft

*   **SwiftKey**: a 2016 sync bug showed users strangers' email addresses and phone numbers as text predictions. <sub>[Exodus](https://reports.exodus-privacy.eu.org/en/reports/com.touchtype.swiftkey/latest/) · [Source](https://www.engadget.com/2016-07-29-swiftkey-leaked-user-email-addresses-as-text-predictions.html)</sub>
*   **[AnySoftKeyboard](https://anysoftkeyboard.github.io/)** - Keyboard with more than 50 languages through add-on packs, plus themes. <sub>Android · Apache-2.0</sub>
*   **[FlorisBoard](https://florisboard.org/)** - Customizable keyboard with themes and add-ons, still in beta. <sub>Android · Apache-2.0 · [F-Droid](https://f-droid.org/packages/dev.patrickgold.florisboard/)</sub>
*   **[FUTO Keyboard](https://keyboard.futo.tech/)** - Keyboard that works fully offline, including voice input, swipe typing and autocorrect. `⚠️ source-available` <sub>Android</sub>
*   **[HeliBoard (⭐6.5k)](https://github.com/HeliBorg/HeliBoard)** - Maintained fork of OpenBoard with glide typing, custom dictionaries and themes, and no internet permission. <sub>Android · GPL-3.0 · [F-Droid](https://f-droid.org/packages/helium314.keyboard/)</sub>
*   **[Indic Keyboard](https://gitlab.com/indicproject/indic-keyboard)** - Keyboard for typing in Indic languages alongside English. <sub>Android · [F-Droid](https://f-droid.org/packages/org.smc.inputmethod.indic/)</sub>
*   **[Simple Keyboard (⭐1.6k)](https://github.com/rkkr/simple-keyboard)** - Minimal keyboard under 1 MB whose only permission is vibrate. <sub>Android · Apache-2.0 · [F-Droid](https://f-droid.org/packages/rkr.simplekeyboard.inputmethod/)</sub>

### Android Launcher / Plugins for Minecraft

*   **[Bliss Launcher](https://gitlab.e.foundation/e/os/BlissLauncher3)** - Default launcher of /e/OS, with app folders and notification badges on icons. <sub>Android</sub>
*   **[KISS](https://kisslauncher.com/)** - Search-first launcher that finds apps, contacts and settings as you type. <sub>Android · GPL-3.0 · [F-Droid](https://f-droid.org/packages/fr.neamar.kiss/)</sub>
*   **[Kvaesitso](https://kvaesitso.mm20.de/)** - Search-focused launcher that finds apps, contacts, files and more from one search bar. <sub>Android · GPL-3.0</sub>
*   **[Lawnchair](https://lawnchair.app/)** - Launcher in the style of the Pixel Launcher, with more customization. <sub>Android</sub>
*   **[Olauncher (⭐3.9k)](https://github.com/tanujnotes/Olauncher)** - Minimal text-only launcher with no ads, meant to cut your screen time. <sub>Android · GPL-3.0 · [F-Droid](https://f-droid.org/packages/app.olauncher/)</sub>
*   **[Pie Launcher (⭐574)](https://github.com/markusfisch/PieLauncher)** - Launcher that opens apps from a pie menu instead of a grid of icons. <sub>Android · MIT · [F-Droid](https://f-droid.org/packages/de.markusfisch.android.pielauncher/)</sub>

### Android SMS / Plugins for Minecraft

*   **[Fossify Messages](https://www.fossify.org/apps/messages/)** - SMS and MMS app with no ads that works without internet access, a fork of Simple SMS Messenger. <sub>Android · GPL-3.0</sub>
*   **[QUIK (⭐2.9k)](https://github.com/quik-sms/quik)** - SMS and MMS app, a maintained fork of QKSMS. <sub>Android · GPL-3.0</sub>

### Android / Android-Based

*   **[/e/OS](https://e.foundation/e-os/)** - Degoogled Android from Murena that bundles microG and optional Murena cloud services.
*   **[iodéOS](https://iode.tech/iodeos/)** - Degoogled Android with a built-in firewall that blocks ads and trackers across apps.
*   **[LineageOS for microG](https://lineage.microg.org/)** - LineageOS builds that ship microG instead of Google Play Services, with F-Droid included.

### Android / Based on Linux

*   **[Mobian](https://mobian-project.org/)** - Debian packaged for mobile devices such as the PinePhone and Librem 5.
*   **[Plasma Mobile](https://plasma-mobile.org/)** - KDE's Plasma desktop adapted for phones, offered by distributions such as Nura.
*   **[Ubuntu Touch](https://ubports.com/)** - Mobile version of Ubuntu, maintained by the UBports community.

### Smart TV / Based on Linux

*   **[LibreELEC](https://libreelec.tv/)** - Minimal Linux system that boots straight into Kodi on Raspberry Pi, x86 and other devices.

### PC / MacOS / [GNU/Linux](https://www.linux.com/what-is-linux/)

*   **[Mint (Cinnamon)](https://linuxmint.com/)** - Beginner-friendly distribution based on Ubuntu, with a desktop that feels familiar to Windows users.
*   **[Qubes OS](https://www.qubes-os.org/)** - Runs each part of your digital life in its own isolated virtual machine, so one compromise doesn't spread.

### Developer Tools / Other OS

*   **[CrowdSec](https://www.crowdsec.net/)** - Collaborative intrusion prevention for servers, like fail2ban with crowd-sourced blocklists. `⚠️ website trackers` <sub>MIT</sub>
*   **[Hetty](https://hetty.xyz/)** - HTTP toolkit for security research, as an alternative to Burp Suite Pro. <sub>MIT</sub>

### IDEs / Other OS

*   **[GNU Emacs](https://www.gnu.org/software/emacs/)** - Extensible, self-documenting editor from the GNU Project that you can shape into a full IDE.

### Version Control / Other OS

*   **GitHub**: owned by Microsoft, and public code hosted there was used to train Copilot. <sub>[ToS;DR](https://tosdr.org/en/service/297)</sub>
*   **[Gitea](https://about.gitea.com/)** - Lightweight self-hosted Git forge, and the project Forgejo was forked from. `⚠️ website trackers` <sub>self-host · MIT</sub>

### Remote Access and Control / Other OS

*   **[Aspia](https://aspia.org/)** - Remote desktop and file transfer with a router you can host yourself, so connections don't depend on a vendor. <sub>self-host · GPL-3.0</sub>
*   **[UltraVNC](https://uvnc.com/)** - VNC server and viewer for Windows, with file transfer and optional encryption plugins. `⚠️ website trackers` <sub>Windows · GPL-3.0</sub>

### ChatGPT / Other OS

*   **[Jan](https://jan.ai/)** - Desktop chat app that runs open models offline, with optional connections to cloud providers.
*   **[LibreChat](https://www.librechat.ai/)** - Self-hosted chat interface that puts many AI providers and local models behind one UI you control. <sub>self-host · MIT</sub>
*   **[LocalAI](https://localai.io/)** - Self-hosted OpenAI-compatible API that runs language, image and voice models on your own hardware. <sub>self-host · MIT</sub>
*   **[ollama](https://ollama.com/)** - Runs open models locally with one command; its optional cloud models can be switched off entirely. <sub>MIT</sub>
*   **[PasteGuard](https://pasteguard.com/)** - Proxy that masks personal data and secrets before your prompts reach a cloud AI provider, then restores them in the reply. <sub>self-host · Apache-2.0</sub>

### AI Coding / Other OS

*   **[OpenCode](https://opencode.ai/)** - Coding agent that connects to local models or any of more than 75 model providers. <sub>MIT</sub>
*   **[Tabby](https://www.tabbyml.com/)** - Self-hosted code completion server that runs on your own hardware, an alternative to GitHub Copilot. `⚠️ telemetry opt-out` `⚠️ website trackers` <sub>self-host</sub>

### Text to Speech / Other OS

*   **[eSpeak NG (⭐7k)](https://github.com/espeak-ng/espeak-ng)** - Compact offline speech synthesizer for more than a hundred languages, robotic-sounding but very light. <sub>GPL-3.0 · [F-Droid](https://f-droid.org/packages/com.reecedunn.espeak/)</sub>

### Speech to Text / Models

*   **[FunASR (⭐21k)](https://github.com/modelscope/FunASR)** - Local speech recognition toolkit with voice detection, punctuation and speaker labels; it downloads models from ModelScope by default. <sub>MIT</sub>
*   **[Moonshine](https://moonshine.ai/)** - Speech recognition models built for fast, low-latency transcription on the device itself.
*   **[OpenAI Whisper (⭐112k)](https://github.com/openai/whisper)** - Speech recognition model you can run offline to transcribe many languages and translate them into English. <sub>MIT</sub>
    *   **[faster-whisper (⭐26k)](https://github.com/SYSTRAN/faster-whisper)** - Whisper reimplemented on CTranslate2, up to four times faster with less memory. <sub>MIT</sub>
    *   **[whisper.cpp (⭐55k)](https://github.com/ggml-org/whisper.cpp)** - C/C++ port of Whisper that runs efficiently on ordinary CPUs and GPUs. <sub>MIT</sub>
*   **[Parakeet TDT](https://huggingface.co/nvidia/parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v3)** - NVIDIA speech recognition model that transcribes quickly and accurately on your own hardware.

### Speech to Text / Apps and services

*   **[FUTO Voice Input](https://voiceinput.futo.org/)** - Voice input for Android that works with other keyboards and runs entirely on the device. `⚠️ source-available` <sub>Android</sub>
*   **[Minutes](https://useminutes.app/)** - Records and transcribes meetings and voice memos on your device, with search over the history for local AI tools.
*   **[OpenWhispr](https://openwhispr.com/)** - Desktop dictation app that can transcribe fully offline with local models, with cloud processing as an option. `⚠️ website trackers` <sub>Linux · macOS · Windows · MIT</sub>
*   **[Sasayaki](https://pluja.github.io/sasayaki/)** - Tiny dictation app that types what you say using any OpenAI-compatible speech server, including your own. <sub>Android</sub>
*   **[Speaches](https://speaches.ai/)** - Self-hosted OpenAI-compatible server for streaming transcription, translation and speech generation. <sub>MIT</sub>
*   **[Vocalinux](https://vocalinux.com/)** - Voice dictation for Linux that types into any app, with speech recognition running on your computer. `⚠️ website trackers` <sub>Linux · AGPL-3.0</sub>

### Image Generation / Apps and services

*   **[ComfyUI](https://www.comfy.org/)** - Node-based interface for building image and video generation pipelines that run on your own machine. `⚠️ website trackers` <sub>GPL-3.0</sub>

### Automation / Apps and services

*   **IFTTT**: your workflows run on its servers, holding tokens to all your connected accounts. <sub>[ToS;DR](https://tosdr.org/en/service/236)</sub>
*   **Zapier**: in 2025 an intruder got into its code repositories, where some customer data had been copied. <sub>[ToS;DR](https://tosdr.org/en/service/2131) · [Source](https://threats.wiz.io/all-incidents/zapier-data-breach)</sub>
*   **[Huginn (⭐50k)](https://github.com/huginn/huginn)** - Self-hosted agents that watch websites, feeds and APIs and act for you, an alternative to IFTTT and Zapier. <sub>self-host · MIT</sub>

### Payments / Apps and services

*   **Visa / Mastercard**: your card purchases feed Mastercard audience segments, like affluent shoppers, sold on data marketplaces. <sub>[Source](https://www.americanbanker.com/news/mastercard-removes-some-ads-for-customer-transaction-data)</sub>
*   **PayPal**: fined $2 million by New York in 2025 after a 2022 breach exposed 35,000 customers' Social Security numbers. <sub>[ToS;DR](https://tosdr.org/en/service/230) · [Source](https://therecord.media/paypal-penalty-millions-data-breach)</sub>
*   **Cash** - Paying in person with notes and coins leaves no record linked to you.

### Full Featured Financial Management / Apps and services

*   **[Sure](https://sure.am)** - Self-hosted personal finance app, a community fork of the archived [Maybe (⭐54k)](https://github.com/maybe-finance/maybe). `⚠️ website trackers` <sub>self-host · AGPL-3.0</sub>

### Budget Management / Apps and services

*   **[My Expenses](https://www.myexpenses.mobi/)** - Expense tracker with multiple accounts, budgets and optional sync through your own cloud storage. <sub>Android · GPL-3.0 · [F-Droid](https://f-droid.org/packages/org.totschnig.myexpenses/) (Play Store version has trackers)</sub>
*   **[ProExpense (⭐104)](https://github.com/arduia/ProExpense)** - Expense notebook for recording your daily spending on the phone. <sub>Android · GPL-3.0 · [F-Droid](https://f-droid.org/packages/com.arduia.expense/) (Play Store version has trackers)</sub>

### Shared Expenses / Apps and services

*   **Tricount**: 8 trackers in its Android app, from Facebook, Google and Huawei among others. <sub>[Exodus](https://reports.exodus-privacy.eu.org/en/reports/com.tribab.tricount.android/latest/)</sub>
*   **Splitwise**: Google and Amazon trackers in its Android app, under a poorly rated privacy policy. <sub>[ToS;DR](https://tosdr.org/en/service/7468) · [Exodus](https://reports.exodus-privacy.eu.org/en/reports/com.Splitwise.SplitwiseMobile/latest/)</sub>
*   **[Spliit](https://spliit.app)** - Splitwise alternative for sharing expenses with friends and family, no account needed. <sub>MIT</sub>
*   **[SplitPro](https://splitpro.app)** - Splitwise alternative for sharing expenses with friends, which you can self-host. <sub>MIT</sub>

### Portfolio trackers / Apps and services

*   **[Ghostfolio](https://ghostfol.io)** - Wealth management app for tracking stocks, ETFs and crypto, which you can self-host. <sub>AGPL-3.0</sub>
*   **[Portfolio Performance](https://www.portfolio-performance.info/en/)** - Desktop app that calculates the overall performance of your investment portfolio, with data kept in local files. <sub>Desktop · EPL-1.0</sub>
*   **[Rotki](https://rotki.com)** - Portfolio tracking, accounting and tax reporting for crypto and other assets, with your data stored locally. <sub>AGPL-3.0</sub>

### Fitness trackers / Apps and services

*   **[FitoTrack](https://codeberg.org/jannis/FitoTrack)** - Workout tracker that records your GPS activities and keeps them on the device. <sub>Android · [F-Droid](https://f-droid.org/packages/de.tadris.fitness/)</sub>
*   **[FitTrackee](https://codeberg.org/FitTrackee/FitTrackee)** - Self-hosted Strava alternative for recording and analyzing outdoor activities from GPS files. <sub>self-host</sub>
*   **[Gadgetbridge](https://gadgetbridge.org/)** - Use your smartwatch or fitness band without the vendor's app or cloud. <sub>Android</sub>
*   **[OpenTracks](https://opentracksapp.com/)** - Sport tracker that records your activities on the device and has no internet permission. <sub>Android</sub>
*   **[RunnerUp (⭐961)](https://github.com/jonasoreland/runnerup)** - Run and bike tracker that keeps activities on the device, with optional sync to services like Strava. <sub>Android · GPL-3.0</sub>

### Workout planners / Apps and services

*   **[wger](https://wger.de/)** - Self-hosted manager for your workouts, exercises and nutrition. <sub>self-host · AGPL-3.0</sub>

### Food / Apps and services

*   **[Open Food Facts](https://world.openfoodfacts.org/)** - Collaborative database of food products, with ingredients, additives and nutrition data. <sub>AGPL-3.0</sub>
    *   **[OFF Apps](https://world.openfoodfacts.org/open-food-facts-mobile-app)** - Mobile apps that scan a product's barcode and show its ingredients, additives and nutrition data. <sub>Android · iOS · Apache-2.0</sub>

### Menstrual cycle trackers / Apps and services

*   **[Bluemoon](https://gitlab.com/ngrob/bluemoon-android)** - Period tracker that keeps your data on the device. <sub>Android · [F-Droid](https://f-droid.org/packages/ch.nilsgrob.android.bluemoon/)</sub>
*   **[Drip](https://dripapp.org/)** - Menstrual cycle and fertility tracker that keeps everything you enter on your device. <sub>Android · iOS · [F-Droid](https://f-droid.org/packages/com.drip/)</sub>
*   **[Euki](https://eukiapp.org/)** - Period and sexual health tracker built to keep your data on your phone. `⚠️ website trackers` <sub>Android · iOS · GPL-3.0</sub>
*   **[Periodical](https://codeberg.org/askaaron/periodical)** - Calendar for tracking your period and estimating fertile days. <sub>Android · [F-Droid](https://f-droid.org/packages/de.arnowelzel.android.periodical/)</sub>
*   **[Poppy](https://poppy.usenostr.org)** - Period tracker in the browser that stores data locally and can sync end-to-end encrypted through Nostr relays, no account needed.

### Dating Apps / Apps and services

*   **Tinder**: a 2020 Norwegian Consumer Council study found it shared user data with at least 45 Match Group firms. <sub>[ToS;DR](https://tosdr.org/en/service/462) · [Exodus](https://reports.exodus-privacy.eu.org/en/reports/com.tinder/latest/) · [Source](https://www.thelocal.no/20200114/norway-consumer-rights-group-accuses-tinder-grindr-of-illegally-sharing-data)</sub>
*   **Grindr**: fined NOK 65 million in Norway in 2021 for sharing users' data with advertisers without valid consent. <sub>[Source](https://techcrunch.com/2021/12/15/grindr-final-gdpr-fine/)</sub>
*   **Badoo**: settled for $40 million in 2024, with Bumble, over claims it scanned Illinois users' faces. <sub>[Exodus](https://reports.exodus-privacy.eu.org/en/reports/com.badoo.mobile/latest/) · [Source](https://idtechwire.com/illinoisan-bumble-badoo-users-may-get-payout-from-40-million-biometric-privacy-settlement/)</sub>
*   **Lovoo**: in 2019 journalists used its Radar feature to locate users to within 30 to 50 meters. <sub>[Exodus](https://reports.exodus-privacy.eu.org/en/reports/net.lovoo.android/latest/) · [Source](https://netzpolitik.org/2019/sicherheitsluecke-dating-app-lovoo-gibt-standortdaten-preis/)</sub>

### Tracking / Apps and services

*   **[Dawarich](https://dawarich.app)** - Self-hosted alternative to Google Timeline for storing and browsing your location history. <sub>self-host · AGPL-3.0</sub>
*   **[Nextcloud PhoneTrack](https://apps.nextcloud.com/apps/phonetrack)** - Nextcloud app for your location history, fed by its [Android app](https://gitlab.com/eneiluj/phonetrack-android) or [other loggers (⭐183)](https://github.com/julien-nc/phonetrack/blob/main/doc/user.md#logging-methods), which can cache positions offline and upload them in batches. <sub>AGPL-3.0</sub>

### Find My Device / Apps and services

*   **[Find My Device](https://fmd-foss.org/)** - Locate and control your Android phone remotely over SMS, messengers or a self-hosted FMD Server. <sub>Android</sub>
*   **[GPSLogger](https://gpslogger.app/)** - Lightweight GPS logger that saves your tracks to local files, with optional uploads to places you choose. <sub>Android · [F-Droid](https://f-droid.org/packages/com.mendhak.gpslogger/)</sub>

### Utilities / Apps and services

*   **[Deskreen](https://deskreen.com/)** - Turns any device with a web browser into a second screen for your computer over the local network. `⚠️ website trackers` <sub>Desktop · AGPL-3.0</sub>
*   **[JustDeleteMe](https://justdeleteme.xyz/)** - Directory of direct links for deleting your accounts from web services, rated by difficulty; sister project [JustGetMyData (⭐169)](https://github.com/daviddavo/jgmd) covers getting your data out. <sub>MIT</sub>
*   **[OpenTabletDriver](https://opentabletdriver.net/)** - User-mode driver for drawing tablets that replaces vendor drivers, some of which [report every app you open](https://robertheaton.com/2020/02/05/wacom-drawing-tablets-track-name-of-every-application-you-open/). <sub>Desktop · LGPL-3.0</sub>

### Privacy vs Security vs Anonymity / Apps and services

*   Privacy is control over your personal information: knowing what is collected about you, and deciding who can access it and how.
*   Security is protection of your information from unauthorized access or theft, so attackers can't get at it.
*   Anonymity means your actions can't be traced back to you. Someone may see what is done, but not who did it.

### Legend / Apps and services

*   `💀 inactive`: development has stalled. It still works and has no maintained alternative, so check before relying on it.
*   `⚠️ closed source`: the code isn't public. Listed only because of a long, trusted record.
*   `⚠️ source-available`: the code is public, but the license isn't an open source one.
*   `⚠️ website trackers`: the project's website loads third-party trackers. That says nothing about the app itself.
*   `⚠️ telemetry opt-out`: the app sends usage data by default, but a setting turns it off.
*   `⚠️ closed server`: the server code isn't public.
*   `⚠️ account required`: an account is needed to use it.
items.content_html:
Medical health / Apps and services

  • MedTimer (⭐648) - Medication reminder that keeps all data on the device and has no internet permission. Android · MIT · F-Droid

Video and Audio Conferencing / Desktop

  • WhatsApp: in 2021 Ireland fined it €225 million for not properly explaining what data it shares with Facebook. ToS;DR · Source
  • Zoom: paid $85 million in 2021 to settle claims it shared user data with Facebook, Google and LinkedIn. ToS;DR · Source
  • BigBlueButton - Self-hosted web conferencing built for online classes, with whiteboard, breakout rooms and recordings. ⚠️ website trackers self-host · LGPL-3.0
  • Briefing - Group video chat in the browser over direct WebRTC connections, with no account. self-host · AGPL-3.0
  • Chitchatter - Serverless, ephemeral peer-to-peer chat with audio, video, screen and file sharing. GPL-2.0
  • Jami - Peer-to-peer audio and video calls and chat with no central servers or account needed. GPL-3.0 · F-Droid
  • Jitsi Meet - Video conferencing you can self-host; the official instance requires you to log in. self-host · Apache-2.0 · F-Droid (Play Store version has trackers)
  • MiroTalk P2P - Browser-based peer-to-peer video calls up to 4K, with nothing to install. AGPL-3.0
  • Mumble - Low-latency voice chat with encrypted connections, on servers you can run yourself. self-host

Instant Messaging

  • Facebook Messenger: chats have been encrypted since 2023, but Meta still sees who you message, when, and who your contacts are. ToS;DR · Exodus · Source

Instagram / Desktop

  • Instagram: Ireland fined Meta €405 million in 2022 for exposing children's emails and phone numbers on Instagram. ToS;DR · Source
  • Pixelfed - Federated photo sharing with posts, stories and a chronological feed, without ads. ActivityPub · AGPL-3.0

Location Tracking / Apps and services

  • Google Find Hub (formerly Find My Device): reports your devices' locations to Google. ToS;DR

Centralized

  • Signal - Messenger with end-to-end encryption for everything by default, run by a nonprofit that keeps almost no user data. AGPL-3.0
  • Threema - Paid messenger from Switzerland that works without a phone number or email. AGPL-3.0

Teamworking Tools / Desktop

  • Wire - End-to-end encrypted messaging, calls and file sharing for teams, with public and audited code for both the apps and the server. ⚠️ website trackers AGPL-3.0 · F-Droid (Play Store version has trackers)
  • Discord: a 2025 breach at a support vendor exposed government ID photos of about 70,000 users. ToS;DR · Source
  • Slack: your messages feed its recommendation models unless a workspace owner emails Slack to opt out. ToS;DR · Source
  • Rocket.Chat - Self-hosted team chat with end-to-end encrypted rooms and federation. ⚠️ website trackers self-host
  • Twake Chat - Workplace chat built on Matrix, part of Linagora's Twake Workplace suite. AGPL-3.0

Maps and Navigation / Apps and services

  • Bing Maps: under Microsoft's very poorly rated privacy policy. ToS;DR
  • Yandex Maps: 11 trackers in its Android app, from a company bound by Russian surveillance law. Exodus
  • Sygic: 8 trackers in its Android app. Exodus
  • OpenStreetMap (OSM) - Collaborative world map built by volunteers, and the open data behind most apps in this section. GPL-2.0
    • OsmAnd - Offline maps and navigation built on OpenStreetMap, with a large set of features. ⚠️ telemetry opt-out Android · iOS · F-Droid
  • Pure Maps - Maps and navigation for Linux phones, Sailfish OS and desktop, fully offline with OSM Scout Server. Linux · GPL-3.0

Search Engines / Useful Tools

  • Yahoo!: a 2013 breach hit all 3 billion Yahoo accounts, which Yahoo admitted only in 2017. ToS;DR · Source
  • Yandex: in 2025 researchers found its Android apps, Yandex Search among them, secretly linked browsing to device IDs. ToS;DR · Source
  • Brave Search - Search engine with its own independent index, from the makers of Brave.
  • DuckDuckGo - Search engine that doesn't build a profile on you, with results drawn largely from Bing.

    • Droid-ify - F-Droid client with a clean interface that can browse any F-Droid repository. Android · GPL-3.0 · F-Droid
  • Obtainium - Installs and updates apps straight from their release pages, such as GitHub or GitLab, and tells you about new versions. Android · GPL-3.0 · F-Droid

Alternative Google Play Store clients / Plugins for Minecraft

  • Aurora Store - Google Play client that can download apps anonymously, without a Google account. ⚠️ website trackers Android

Android Debloat Tools / Plugins for Minecraft

  • ADB AppControl: its terms let it send your PC's IP, hardware details and the apps you remove to a remote server. Source
  • Universal Android Debloater Next Generation (⭐9.7k) - Desktop app that removes preinstalled bloatware from Android phones over ADB, no root needed. Desktop · GPL-3.0

Android Dialer / Plugins for Minecraft

  • Fossify Phone - Phone app with a phonebook, number blocking and multi-SIM support, part of the Fossify fork of Simple Mobile Tools. Android · GPL-3.0 · F-Droid

Android File Manager / Plugins for Minecraft

  • Amaze File Manager (⭐6.5k) - Material Design file manager with root access and a built-in FTP server. Android · GPL-3.0 · F-Droid
  • Fossify File Manager - File manager with no ads or tracking that works without internet access. Android · GPL-3.0 · F-Droid
  • Ghost Commander - Dual-panel file manager. Android · F-Droid
  • Material Files (⭐9.4k) - Material Design file manager with root, archive, FTP, SFTP, SMB and WebDAV support. Android · GPL-3.0 · F-Droid

Android Keyboard / Plugins for Minecraft

  • SwiftKey: a 2016 sync bug showed users strangers' email addresses and phone numbers as text predictions. Exodus · Source
  • AnySoftKeyboard - Keyboard with more than 50 languages through add-on packs, plus themes. Android · Apache-2.0
  • FlorisBoard - Customizable keyboard with themes and add-ons, still in beta. Android · Apache-2.0 · F-Droid
  • FUTO Keyboard - Keyboard that works fully offline, including voice input, swipe typing and autocorrect. ⚠️ source-available Android
  • HeliBoard (⭐6.5k) - Maintained fork of OpenBoard with glide typing, custom dictionaries and themes, and no internet permission. Android · GPL-3.0 · F-Droid
  • Indic Keyboard - Keyboard for typing in Indic languages alongside English. Android · F-Droid
  • Simple Keyboard (⭐1.6k) - Minimal keyboard under 1 MB whose only permission is vibrate. Android · Apache-2.0 · F-Droid

Android Launcher / Plugins for Minecraft

  • Bliss Launcher - Default launcher of /e/OS, with app folders and notification badges on icons. Android
  • KISS - Search-first launcher that finds apps, contacts and settings as you type. Android · GPL-3.0 · F-Droid
  • Kvaesitso - Search-focused launcher that finds apps, contacts, files and more from one search bar. Android · GPL-3.0
  • Lawnchair - Launcher in the style of the Pixel Launcher, with more customization. Android
  • Olauncher (⭐3.9k) - Minimal text-only launcher with no ads, meant to cut your screen time. Android · GPL-3.0 · F-Droid
  • Pie Launcher (⭐574) - Launcher that opens apps from a pie menu instead of a grid of icons. Android · MIT · F-Droid

Android SMS / Plugins for Minecraft

  • Fossify Messages - SMS and MMS app with no ads that works without internet access, a fork of Simple SMS Messenger. Android · GPL-3.0
  • QUIK (⭐2.9k) - SMS and MMS app, a maintained fork of QKSMS. Android · GPL-3.0

Android / Android-Based

  • /e/OS - Degoogled Android from Murena that bundles microG and optional Murena cloud services.
  • iodéOS - Degoogled Android with a built-in firewall that blocks ads and trackers across apps.
  • LineageOS for microG - LineageOS builds that ship microG instead of Google Play Services, with F-Droid included.

Android / Based on Linux

  • Mobian - Debian packaged for mobile devices such as the PinePhone and Librem 5.
  • Plasma Mobile - KDE's Plasma desktop adapted for phones, offered by distributions such as Nura.
  • Ubuntu Touch - Mobile version of Ubuntu, maintained by the UBports community.

Smart TV / Based on Linux

  • LibreELEC - Minimal Linux system that boots straight into Kodi on Raspberry Pi, x86 and other devices.

PC / MacOS / GNU/Linux

  • Mint (Cinnamon) - Beginner-friendly distribution based on Ubuntu, with a desktop that feels familiar to Windows users.
  • Qubes OS - Runs each part of your digital life in its own isolated virtual machine, so one compromise doesn't spread.

Developer Tools / Other OS

  • CrowdSec - Collaborative intrusion prevention for servers, like fail2ban with crowd-sourced blocklists. ⚠️ website trackers MIT
  • Hetty - HTTP toolkit for security research, as an alternative to Burp Suite Pro. MIT

IDEs / Other OS

  • GNU Emacs - Extensible, self-documenting editor from the GNU Project that you can shape into a full IDE.

Version Control / Other OS

  • GitHub: owned by Microsoft, and public code hosted there was used to train Copilot. ToS;DR
  • Gitea - Lightweight self-hosted Git forge, and the project Forgejo was forked from. ⚠️ website trackers self-host · MIT

Remote Access and Control / Other OS

  • Aspia - Remote desktop and file transfer with a router you can host yourself, so connections don't depend on a vendor. self-host · GPL-3.0
  • UltraVNC - VNC server and viewer for Windows, with file transfer and optional encryption plugins. ⚠️ website trackers Windows · GPL-3.0

ChatGPT / Other OS

  • Jan - Desktop chat app that runs open models offline, with optional connections to cloud providers.
  • LibreChat - Self-hosted chat interface that puts many AI providers and local models behind one UI you control. self-host · MIT
  • LocalAI - Self-hosted OpenAI-compatible API that runs language, image and voice models on your own hardware. self-host · MIT
  • ollama - Runs open models locally with one command; its optional cloud models can be switched off entirely. MIT
  • PasteGuard - Proxy that masks personal data and secrets before your prompts reach a cloud AI provider, then restores them in the reply. self-host · Apache-2.0

AI Coding / Other OS

  • OpenCode - Coding agent that connects to local models or any of more than 75 model providers. MIT
  • Tabby - Self-hosted code completion server that runs on your own hardware, an alternative to GitHub Copilot. ⚠️ telemetry opt-out ⚠️ website trackers self-host

Text to Speech / Other OS

  • eSpeak NG (⭐7k) - Compact offline speech synthesizer for more than a hundred languages, robotic-sounding but very light. GPL-3.0 · F-Droid

Speech to Text / Models

  • FunASR (⭐21k) - Local speech recognition toolkit with voice detection, punctuation and speaker labels; it downloads models from ModelScope by default. MIT
  • Moonshine - Speech recognition models built for fast, low-latency transcription on the device itself.
  • OpenAI Whisper (⭐112k) - Speech recognition model you can run offline to transcribe many languages and translate them into English. MIT
    • faster-whisper (⭐26k) - Whisper reimplemented on CTranslate2, up to four times faster with less memory. MIT
    • whisper.cpp (⭐55k) - C/C++ port of Whisper that runs efficiently on ordinary CPUs and GPUs. MIT
  • Parakeet TDT - NVIDIA speech recognition model that transcribes quickly and accurately on your own hardware.

Speech to Text / Apps and services

  • FUTO Voice Input - Voice input for Android that works with other keyboards and runs entirely on the device. ⚠️ source-available Android
  • Minutes - Records and transcribes meetings and voice memos on your device, with search over the history for local AI tools.
  • OpenWhispr - Desktop dictation app that can transcribe fully offline with local models, with cloud processing as an option. ⚠️ website trackers Linux · macOS · Windows · MIT
  • Sasayaki - Tiny dictation app that types what you say using any OpenAI-compatible speech server, including your own. Android
  • Speaches - Self-hosted OpenAI-compatible server for streaming transcription, translation and speech generation. MIT
  • Vocalinux - Voice dictation for Linux that types into any app, with speech recognition running on your computer. ⚠️ website trackers Linux · AGPL-3.0

Image Generation / Apps and services

  • ComfyUI - Node-based interface for building image and video generation pipelines that run on your own machine. ⚠️ website trackers GPL-3.0

Automation / Apps and services

  • IFTTT: your workflows run on its servers, holding tokens to all your connected accounts. ToS;DR
  • Zapier: in 2025 an intruder got into its code repositories, where some customer data had been copied. ToS;DR · Source
  • Huginn (⭐50k) - Self-hosted agents that watch websites, feeds and APIs and act for you, an alternative to IFTTT and Zapier. self-host · MIT

Payments / Apps and services

  • Visa / Mastercard: your card purchases feed Mastercard audience segments, like affluent shoppers, sold on data marketplaces. Source
  • PayPal: fined $2 million by New York in 2025 after a 2022 breach exposed 35,000 customers' Social Security numbers. ToS;DR · Source
  • Cash - Paying in person with notes and coins leaves no record linked to you.

Full Featured Financial Management / Apps and services

  • Sure - Self-hosted personal finance app, a community fork of the archived Maybe (⭐54k). ⚠️ website trackers self-host · AGPL-3.0

Budget Management / Apps and services

  • My Expenses - Expense tracker with multiple accounts, budgets and optional sync through your own cloud storage. Android · GPL-3.0 · F-Droid (Play Store version has trackers)
  • ProExpense (⭐104) - Expense notebook for recording your daily spending on the phone. Android · GPL-3.0 · F-Droid (Play Store version has trackers)

Shared Expenses / Apps and services

  • Tricount: 8 trackers in its Android app, from Facebook, Google and Huawei among others. Exodus
  • Splitwise: Google and Amazon trackers in its Android app, under a poorly rated privacy policy. ToS;DR · Exodus
  • Spliit - Splitwise alternative for sharing expenses with friends and family, no account needed. MIT
  • SplitPro - Splitwise alternative for sharing expenses with friends, which you can self-host. MIT

Portfolio trackers / Apps and services

  • Ghostfolio - Wealth management app for tracking stocks, ETFs and crypto, which you can self-host. AGPL-3.0
  • Portfolio Performance - Desktop app that calculates the overall performance of your investment portfolio, with data kept in local files. Desktop · EPL-1.0
  • Rotki - Portfolio tracking, accounting and tax reporting for crypto and other assets, with your data stored locally. AGPL-3.0

Fitness trackers / Apps and services

  • FitoTrack - Workout tracker that records your GPS activities and keeps them on the device. Android · F-Droid
  • FitTrackee - Self-hosted Strava alternative for recording and analyzing outdoor activities from GPS files. self-host
  • Gadgetbridge - Use your smartwatch or fitness band without the vendor's app or cloud. Android
  • OpenTracks - Sport tracker that records your activities on the device and has no internet permission. Android
  • RunnerUp (⭐961) - Run and bike tracker that keeps activities on the device, with optional sync to services like Strava. Android · GPL-3.0

Workout planners / Apps and services

  • wger - Self-hosted manager for your workouts, exercises and nutrition. self-host · AGPL-3.0

Food / Apps and services

  • Open Food Facts - Collaborative database of food products, with ingredients, additives and nutrition data. AGPL-3.0
    • OFF Apps - Mobile apps that scan a product's barcode and show its ingredients, additives and nutrition data. Android · iOS · Apache-2.0

Menstrual cycle trackers / Apps and services

  • Bluemoon - Period tracker that keeps your data on the device. Android · F-Droid
  • Drip - Menstrual cycle and fertility tracker that keeps everything you enter on your device. Android · iOS · F-Droid
  • Euki - Period and sexual health tracker built to keep your data on your phone. ⚠️ website trackers Android · iOS · GPL-3.0
  • Periodical - Calendar for tracking your period and estimating fertile days. Android · F-Droid
  • Poppy - Period tracker in the browser that stores data locally and can sync end-to-end encrypted through Nostr relays, no account needed.

Dating Apps / Apps and services

  • Tinder: a 2020 Norwegian Consumer Council study found it shared user data with at least 45 Match Group firms. ToS;DR · Exodus · Source
  • Grindr: fined NOK 65 million in Norway in 2021 for sharing users' data with advertisers without valid consent. Source
  • Badoo: settled for $40 million in 2024, with Bumble, over claims it scanned Illinois users' faces. Exodus · Source
  • Lovoo: in 2019 journalists used its Radar feature to locate users to within 30 to 50 meters. Exodus · Source

Tracking / Apps and services

  • Dawarich - Self-hosted alternative to Google Timeline for storing and browsing your location history. self-host · AGPL-3.0
  • Nextcloud PhoneTrack - Nextcloud app for your location history, fed by its Android app or other loggers (⭐183), which can cache positions offline and upload them in batches. AGPL-3.0

Find My Device / Apps and services

  • Find My Device - Locate and control your Android phone remotely over SMS, messengers or a self-hosted FMD Server. Android
  • GPSLogger - Lightweight GPS logger that saves your tracks to local files, with optional uploads to places you choose. Android · F-Droid

Utilities / Apps and services

  • Deskreen - Turns any device with a web browser into a second screen for your computer over the local network. ⚠️ website trackers Desktop · AGPL-3.0
  • JustDeleteMe - Directory of direct links for deleting your accounts from web services, rated by difficulty; sister project JustGetMyData (⭐169) covers getting your data out. MIT
  • OpenTabletDriver - User-mode driver for drawing tablets that replaces vendor drivers, some of which report every app you open. Desktop · LGPL-3.0

Privacy vs Security vs Anonymity / Apps and services

  • Privacy is control over your personal information: knowing what is collected about you, and deciding who can access it and how.
  • Security is protection of your information from unauthorized access or theft, so attackers can't get at it.
  • Anonymity means your actions can't be traced back to you. Someone may see what is done, but not who did it.

Legend / Apps and services

  • 💀 inactive: development has stalled. It still works and has no maintained alternative, so check before relying on it.
  • ⚠️ closed source: the code isn't public. Listed only because of a long, trusted record.
  • ⚠️ source-available: the code is public, but the license isn't an open source one.
  • ⚠️ website trackers: the project's website loads third-party trackers. That says nothing about the app itself.
  • ⚠️ telemetry opt-out: the app sends usage data by default, but a setting turns it off.
  • ⚠️ closed server: the server code isn't public.
  • ⚠️ account required: an account is needed to use it.
