items.title: Awesome Mac
items.content_text:
### Reading and Writing Tools / Note-taking

*   [Koru](https://www.koru.do/?utm_source=github\&utm_medium=awesome-list\&utm_campaign=awesome-mac) - Offline-first, open-source workspace for notes and docs with end-to-end encrypted device-to-device sync, built in Rust. [![Open-Source Software](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-oss.svg "Open Source Software")](https://github.com/koruworks/mono) ![Freeware](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-free.svg "Freeware")

### Reading and Writing Tools / Writing

*   [Drifting](https://drifting.cc/) - Open-source, local-first novel writing app with chapters, outline, characters and storylines, and an AI agent that can read and edit the whole project. [![Open-Source Software](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-oss.svg "Open Source Software")](https://github.com/chihumyum/Drifting) ![Freeware](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-free.svg "Freeware")

### Reading and Writing Tools / Others

*   [Saywing](https://www.christopherboebel.com/en/saywing) - Open-source tool that reads selected screen regions aloud using local OCR and neural speech, with offline English and German dictation. [![Open-Source Software](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-oss.svg "Open Source Software")](https://github.com/ChrBoebel/saywing) ![Freeware](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-free.svg "Freeware")

### Developer Tools / IDEs

*   [Coincide](https://coincide.dev) - Open-source native workspace for coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Grok Build, OpenCode, Antigravity), where one thread can switch agents mid-conversation. [![Open-Source Software](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-oss.svg "Open Source Software")](https://github.com/apoorvdarshan/coincide) ![Freeware](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-free.svg "Freeware") ![Native App](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-native-app.svg "Native App")

### Developer Tools / Developer Utilities

*   [Breaker (⭐0)](https://github.com/wata/Breaker) - Watches the launchd jobs, cron jobs, Folder Actions, and SwiftBar plugins you set up yourself and notifies you when one breaks. [![Open-Source Software](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-oss.svg "Open Source Software")](https://github.com/wata/Breaker) ![Freeware](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-free.svg "Freeware") ![Native App](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-native-app.svg "Native App")
*   [mirroir-mcp](https://mirroir.dev) - Open-source MCP server and CLI that lets AI agents see, tap, swipe and type on a real iPhone through iPhone Mirroring, without Developer Mode or Xcode. [![Open-Source Software](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-oss.svg "Open Source Software")](https://github.com/jfarcand/mirroir-mcp) ![Freeware](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-free.svg "Freeware")

### Terminal Apps / Databases

*   [lmux (⭐26)](https://github.com/sooftware/lmux) - Lightweight terminal built on libghostty for running Claude Code and Codex sessions, with agent status in the sidebar. [![Open-Source Software](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-oss.svg "Open Source Software")](https://github.com/sooftware/lmux) ![Freeware](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-free.svg "Freeware")
*   [SSHTermaq](https://f1resh.github.io/sshtermaq/) - PuTTY-compatible SSH, Telnet and serial terminal with tabs, split panes, an SFTP/SCP file manager and one-click PuTTY session import. [![Open-Source Software](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-oss.svg "Open Source Software")](https://github.com/f1resh/sshtermaq) ![Freeware](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-free.svg "Freeware")

### Design and Product / Screenshot Tools

*   [Shutterbar (⭐1)](https://github.com/mucahitimre/Shutterbar) - ShareX-style screenshots with ⌘C-to-clipboard, after-capture tasks, last-region recapture and scrolling capture. [![Open-Source Software](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-oss.svg "Open Source Software")](https://github.com/mucahitimre/Shutterbar) ![Freeware](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-free.svg "Freeware") ![Native App](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-native-app.svg "Native App")

### Design and Product / Screen Recording

*   [TinyRecorder](https://www.tinyrecorder.app/en/) - Lightweight screen recorder for screens, windows, apps, system audio and a connected iPhone or iPad; a maintained fork of QuickRecorder. [![Open-Source Software](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-oss.svg "Open Source Software")](https://github.com/33to9/TinyRecorder) ![Freeware](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-free.svg "Freeware")

### Design and Product / Other Tools

*   [Flipic (⭐6)](https://github.com/xmasdong/flipic) - Photo culling viewer: arrow-key paging through a folder, 100% focus check, XMP ratings that Lightroom and Capture One read, on-device cleanup mode. [![Open-Source Software](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-oss.svg "Open Source Software")](https://github.com/xmasdong/flipic) ![Freeware](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-free.svg "Freeware")
*   [Graphis (⭐2)](https://github.com/Campfire7/graphis) - Open-source app that generates images from text with the MOSS-Image model, locally on Apple silicon. [![Open-Source Software](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-oss.svg "Open Source Software")](https://github.com/Campfire7/graphis) ![Freeware](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-free.svg "Freeware")
*   [LumaView](https://ixiehao.github.io/LumaView/en/) - Minimal native image viewer for browsing folders, inspecting EXIF metadata, and reading multipage PDFs. [![Open-Source Software](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-oss.svg "Open Source Software")](https://github.com/ixiehao/LumaView) ![Freeware](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-free.svg "Freeware")

### AI Tools / Other Tools

*   [Murmury (⭐1)](https://github.com/GianlucaBave/murmury) - Floating window that answers questions from your own documents during video calls, hidden from screen sharing, with on-device speech recognition. [![Open-Source Software](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-oss.svg "Open Source Software")](https://github.com/GianlucaBave/murmury) ![Freeware](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-free.svg "Freeware")

### Audio and Video Tools / File Sharing

*   [MP4Flow](https://ixiehao.github.io/MP4Flow/en/) - Native FFmpeg front end for batch video-to-MP4 conversion, trimming, cropping, rotating, and merging. [![Open-Source Software](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-oss.svg "Open Source Software")](https://github.com/ixiehao/MP4Flow) ![Freeware](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-free.svg "Freeware")
*   [Radif](https://www.yuvrajangadsingh.com/radif) - Unofficial open-source YouTube Music client built with Tauri, with synced lyrics and a video mode, that needs YouTube Music Premium. items.title: Awesome Testing
items.content_text:
### Software / API Testing

*   [Bifurc (⭐4)](https://github.com/HarshalKudale/bifurc) - Local-first API client, mock server and traffic proxy for macOS, Windows and Linux, with a CLI for CI.

### Software / AI & LLM Testing

*   [llmdrill (⭐0)](https://github.com/hamarshehmhmd/llmdrill) - Open-source CLI that runs your app behind a local fake of the Anthropic and OpenAI APIs, injects outages (529/503 overloads, 429 with retry-after, hangs, cut streams) and grades its retries, backoff, timeouts and failover.
*   [evalship](https://evalship.com/) - GitHub App that finds flaws in your LLM evals, says on every pull request which evals a change broke and why, and finds prompt and model changes that win beyond chance.

### Software / UI & End-to-End Testing

*   [GenClass (⭐7)](https://github.com/genclass-dev/GenClass) - Open-source browser library that reports race conditions in a web app while they happen (stale responses written over newer data, duplicate submits, failure storms) with a small on-device model. Its local MCP server re-runs a page with responses delivered in different orders to find races and replays one order to prove a fix.
*   [mendwright (⭐0)](https://github.com/saadbuilt/mendwright) - Self-healing selectors for Playwright and Selenium in Python. Repairs a broken selector from a saved fingerprint of the element, asks a model only when that isn't enough, checks the repair on the live page and can write it back into your code.
*   [Replay QA](https://replay.io/) - Autonomous QA agent for web apps built on Replay's time-travel runtime recording and analysis. It explores an app from its URL, writes and runs Playwright tests, and delivers a root-cause analysis for each failure, backed by evidence from the recorded execution. Free tier, no credit card.

### Software / Test Data Management

*   [Brume (⭐7)](https://github.com/brumeorg/Brume) - Copies a subset of a PostgreSQL database to a test environment, pseudonymizing personal data and keeping foreign keys valid.

### Software / Test Automation Frameworks

*   [bareenv (⭐0)](https://github.com/Blasword/bareenv) - Runs a command once per environment combination (unset, empty, invalid) and reports the ones that break.
*   [Cerulion (⭐101)](https://github.com/cerulion-inc/cerulion) - Open-source robot runtime that records each run and re-executes supported native recordings against new code, exiting 1 with the name of the topic that changed, so a recorded robot run becomes a CI regression test.

items.content_text:

*   [xerj-org/xerj (⭐19k)](https://github.com/xerj-org/xerj) - Search engine for AI agents in one binary: BM25, vector and hybrid search over an Elasticsearch-compatible API, with a built-in MCP server

*   [cerulion-inc/cerulion (⭐101)](https://github.com/cerulion-inc/cerulion) \[[cerulion\_cli](https://crates.io/crates/cerulion_cli)] - Robot runtime with zero-copy shared memory and a graph-aware scheduler. Records a run and re-executes supported native recordings against new code, with an exit code for CI. [![CI](https://github.com/cerulion-inc/cerulion/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg?branch=main)](https://github.com/cerulion-inc/cerulion/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

A Rust port of CLIProxyAPI. [![CI](https://github.com/vayungodara/cliproxy-rs/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg?branch=master)](https://github.com/vayungodara/cliproxy-rs/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

*   [Skykeep (⭐129)](https://github.com/YashwanthKamireddi/Skykeep) - iCloud Notes, Reminders, Calendar, Contacts, Drive and Photos as desktop apps for Linux and Windows, kept in a local library that works offline [![CI](https://github.com/YashwanthKamireddi/Skykeep/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg?branch=main)](https://github.com/YashwanthKamireddi/Skykeep/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

### Applications / Text editors

*   [sventmueller/splat (⭐4)](https://github.com/sventmueller/splat) - An ultrafast native Markdown editor for macOS on AppKit, no Electron. [![build badge](https://github.com/sventmueller/splat/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg?branch=main)](https://github.com/sventmueller/splat/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

*   [0xS4N4TG/kinetograph (⭐440)](https://github.com/0xS4N4TG/kinetograph) - Programmatic video engine: a Skia and wgpu compositor, called from Node, that renders Remotion-style TypeScript and HTML to video without a browser. [![build badge](https://github.com/0xS4N4TG/kinetograph/actions/workflows/native.yml/badge.svg?branch=main)](https://github.com/0xS4N4TG/kinetograph/actions/workflows/native.yml)

items.title: ALL About RSS
items.content_text:
### RSS2Notification / RSS2GitHubProfile

*   [Topic Watch (⭐15)](https://github.com/0xzerolight/topic_watch) : self-hosted news monitor that uses an LLM to only notify on genuinely new information [![Open-Source Software](https://github.com/AboutRSS/ALL-about-RSS/raw/master/media/open-source.png)](https://github.com/0xzerolight/topic_watch)![Freeware](https://github.com/AboutRSS/ALL-about-RSS/raw/master/media/icons8-one-free-16.png)![AI](https://github.com/AboutRSS/ALL-about-RSS/raw/master/media/icons8-ai-16.png)

### Apps / Outline Processor Markup Language

*   [Newsbin](https://xetabit.com/apps/newsbin/) : a native RSS reader for iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple Watch with optional on-device AI, free to try [![iPhone](https://github.com/AboutRSS/ALL-about-RSS/raw/master/media/icons8-iphone-16.png)](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/newsbin/id6737723338)[![Mac](https://github.com/AboutRSS/ALL-about-RSS/raw/master/media/icons8-mac-client-16.png)](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/newsbin/id6737723338)
*   [Feedler](https://feedlerapp.com/) : a smart RSS reader with an in-house full-article parser and cross-source Trending Stories, free for five feeds then €9.99/year [![iPhone](https://github.com/AboutRSS/ALL-about-RSS/raw/master/media/icons8-iphone-16.png)](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6777101828)

### Hosted Readers / Outline Processor Markup Language

*   [Sublime Feed](https://sublimefeed.com/) : an RSS reader without unread counts, free for five feeds then $4/month or $40/year ![Online](https://github.com/AboutRSS/ALL-about-RSS/raw/master/media/icons8-web-design-16.png)

### Self Hosted Readers / Outline Processor Markup Language

*   [FeedThing (⭐5)](https://github.com/xurble/FeedThing) : a Django reader with a two-pane catch-up model and river-of-news folders, self-hosted on gunicorn [![Open-Source Software](https://github.com/AboutRSS/ALL-about-RSS/raw/master/media/open-source.png)](https://github.com/xurble/FeedThing)![Freeware](https://github.com/AboutRSS/ALL-about-RSS/raw/master/media/icons8-one-free-16.png)
*   [Tuvix](https://tuvix.app/) : an open-source RSS aggregator, self-host it or use the free hosted app [![Online](https://github.com/AboutRSS/ALL-about-RSS/raw/master/media/icons8-web-design-16.png)](https://feed.tuvix.app/)[![Open-Source Software](https://github.com/AboutRSS/ALL-about-RSS/raw/master/media/open-source.png)](https://github.com/TechSquidTV/Tuvix-RSS)
*   [Simple Feed Reader (⭐8)](https://github.com/larspohlmann/simple-feed-reader) : a self-hosted multi-user reader with full-text extraction, email digests and Bluesky/Mastodon timelines and lists as feeds, Docker Compose deploy [![Open-Source Software](https://github.com/AboutRSS/ALL-about-RSS/raw/master/media/open-source.png)](https://github.com/larspohlmann/simple-feed-reader)

### 🧾Other Lists that Collect RSS Things / Outline Processor Markup Language

*   [The RSS Universe](https://toolbox.rss.here.now/) : a living directory of 133 RSS apps, tools and standards, links checked live

### NetNewsWire / Outline Processor Markup Language

*   [thechelsuk NetNewsWire Themes](https://themes-nnw.thechels.uk/): a bundle of light, dark and adjustable themes [![Open-Source Software](https://github.com/AboutRSS/ALL-about-RSS/raw/master/media/open-source.png)](https://github.com/thechelsuk/uk.thechels.themes-nnw)

### ✳ Information Aggregators / 酷Q Plugin

*   [Trace](https://www.yourtrace.online/): tech and AI news from 100+ sources (RSS/Atom feeds, Hacker News, Reddit, Product Hunt), merged into one story per event with every source linked; a web page, a daily email and public daily briefs, self-hostable with Docker Compose [![Online](https://github.com/AboutRSS/ALL-about-RSS/raw/master/media/icons8-web-design-16.png)](https://www.yourtrace.online/)[![Chrome](https://github.com/AboutRSS/ALL-about-RSS/raw/master/media/Google_Chrome.png)](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/trace-ai-tech-news-in-eve/cblkklekbejbbpcaihfogdmaoofmikbk)[![Open-Source Software](https://github.com/AboutRSS/ALL-about-RSS/raw/master/media/open-source.png)](https://github.com/TarunTomar122/trace)![Freeware](https://github.com/AboutRSS/ALL-about-RSS/raw/master/media/icons8-one-free-16.png)![AI](https://github.com/AboutRSS/ALL-about-RSS/raw/master/media/icons8-ai-16.png)[![MCP](https://github.com/AboutRSS/ALL-about-RSS/raw/master/media/icons8-model-context-protocol-16.png)](https://www.yourtrace.online/agents)

### specifically from (*a certain platform*) / Steam

*   [Owned Steam Game RSS Feeds](https://steam-rss.zackboe.hm) : generates an .opml of news feeds for the games you own, optionally including wishlisted, free and unplayed titles ![Online](https://github.com/AboutRSS/ALL-about-RSS/raw/master/media/icons8-web-design-16.png)![Freeware](https://github.com/AboutRSS/ALL-about-RSS/raw/master/media/icons8-one-free-16.png)

### specifically from (*a certain platform*) / TMDB

*   [Magnanium](https://magnanium.vercel.app/) : generates an RSS feed for the upcoming releases of any actor or director, filterable by role, release type and lead time ![Online](https://github.com/AboutRSS/ALL-about-RSS/raw/master/media/icons8-web-design-16.png)![Freeware](https://github.com/AboutRSS/ALL-about-RSS/raw/master/media/icons8-one-free-16.png)

### Toolbox / Webpage Monitor Services with capability of monitoring RSS Feed [1264](https://t.me/s/aboutrss/1264)

*   [FeedCraft (⭐313)](https://github.com/Colin-XKL/FeedCraft): an RSS middleware in Go that translates, extracts full text, renders JS-heavy pages, and summarizes or filters items with an LLM [![Open-Source Software](https://github.com/AboutRSS/ALL-about-RSS/raw/master/media/open-source.png)](https://github.com/Colin-XKL/FeedCraft)![Freeware](https://github.com/AboutRSS/ALL-about-RSS/raw/master/media/icons8-one-free-16.png)![AI](https://github.com/AboutRSS/ALL-about-RSS/raw/master/media/icons8-ai-16.png)

### Feed item filtering / Webpage Monitor Services with capability of monitoring RSS Feed [1264](https://t.me/s/aboutrss/1264)

*   [Feed Rinse](http://feedrinse.com/index-old.php): filter items out by keyword, author or category; the link goes to the pre-2.0 site, which is still the only working one ![Freeware](https://github.com/AboutRSS/ALL-about-RSS/raw/master/media/icons8-one-free-16.png)

### News / Webpage Monitor Services with capability of monitoring RSS Feed [1264](https://t.me/s/aboutrss/1264)

*   [Cheltenham Open Data feeds](https://cheltenham-od.uk/feeds): local feeds for Cheltenham, UK, including a daily news round-up and an alerts feed that merges flood warnings, power cuts, travel disruption and road closures

### Tech or IT / Crypto or Blockchain relevant

*   [RealMarketFeed](https://rss.realmarketapi.com/): a curated directory of trading news feeds (crypto, forex, stocks, macro), with an [OPML file](https://rss.realmarketapi.com/opml.xml) of every feed and a combined [feed](https://rss.realmarketapi.com/feed.xml) [![Open-Source Software](https://github.com/AboutRSS/ALL-about-RSS/raw/master/media/open-source.png)](https://github.com/Phideround/RealMarketFeed)

### Multi-subject / Crypto or Blockchain relevant

*   [MyFeed](https://myfeed.space/explore) : 103 public topic feeds (AI, Rust, security, privacy and more), each built from hundreds of RSS sources and news outlets and AI-picked into one feed; every topic publishes its own RSS, e.g. [AI](https://myfeed.space/ai/rss.xml), [Rust](https://myfeed.space/rust/rss.xml) and [Privacy](https://myfeed.space/explore/privacy/rss.xml) ![Online](https://github.com/AboutRSS/ALL-about-RSS/raw/master/media/icons8-web-design-16.png)![AI](https://github.com/AboutRSS/ALL-about-RSS/raw/master/media/icons8-ai-16.png)

### Aggregators of Podcasts / Podcast Navigation / Crypto or Blockchain relevant

items.title: Free for Dev
items.content_text:
### APIs, Data, and ML

*   [DocSpring](https://docspring.com) - Fill out PDF forms, generate PDFs and Word documents, and collect e-signatures. Free developer plan includes unlimited test PDFs and 10 filled PDFs per month. Up to 10 templates, 2 users, and 2 integrations. No credit card required and no time limits.
*   [TimeLogic API](https://timelogicapi.com) - World time and timezone API with cryptographically signed JSON responses, so you can verify the time wasn't tampered with. Get the current time by timezone, IP address or coordinates, convert between zones, check DST changes, and do business-day date math. WorldTimeAPI-compatible endpoints for apps that used worldtimeapi.org. Free plan includes 10,000 requests/month on all endpoints.

### Security and PKI

*   [CertAvert](https://certavert.com/monitoring) - Monitor SSL/TLS certificates on any port, checks expiry, chain problems, revocation, host mismatch. Monitor 15 domains free, get expiry notifications, email, Slack or Discord. No credit card required for signup.
*   [CyberShield Studio](https://cybershieldstudio.com/) - Security monitoring for e-commerce store operators and developers. Weekly scans for JavaScript changes or injection, tracking before consent, security header settings, and vulnerable client-side libraries and WordPress plugins. Free plan monitors 1 store (home page + checkout path) with 30 days of history. No credit card required.

### Monitoring

*   [Gairė](https://gaire.lt/en) - Web Change monitoring for research, price changes, out-of/in stock monitoring. Free plan up to 10 pages checked every hour, alerts by sms, email, Webhook, Slack/Discord/Telegram integrations. No card needed.
*   [hypermonitors.com](https://hypermonitors.com) - Monitors your infrastructure from three different locations (ZH - NYC - SG) with every outage checked from a 2nd location before alerts go out. Free forever for 5 monitors and 5 minute checks.
*   [PingWise](https://pingwise.com/) - Quorum-based uptime monitoring, using 15 probes in 6 different continents. Pricing is credit based, offering 650,000 free checks per month (translates to 75 free monitors at 5-minute checks). No credit card, unlimited users.
*   [RealUptime](https://realuptime.io) - Uptime checks from 4 regions every 3 minutes, a public status page with 100 subscribers, and API, CLI, Terraform and MCP access. Free for 10 monitors, commercial use allowed, no card required.

### Crash and Exception Handling

*   [RealUptime Errors](https://realuptime.io/errors) - Error tracking that works with Sentry SDKs. Free for 10,000 events a month with 14-day retention; past the cap, events are refused and counted, never billed.

### Email

*   [mxRaven](https://mxraven.com/) - Programmable inbound email infrastructure with webhook, forward, and auto-reply routing, plus a durable pull-based event stream for consuming mail without a public endpoint. Free tier includes 1,000 outbound and 1,000 inbound tasks per month, 1 workspace, and 1 domain.

### Forms

*   [whatayarn](https://whatayarn.com/) - Online form builder. Unlimited forms and responses on Free, subject to fair use.

### Generative AI

*   [evalship](https://evalship.com) - find the flaws in your LLM evals. Reviews your evals suite for improvement opportunities, monitors your PRs for any eval regressions or unintended side effects and optimizes your prompts and models based on experiments in your product. Free for 1 private repo for 1 user, 100 PR analyses a month, 30 days of eval history. Free for public repos.

### PaaS

*   [EthioDeploy](https://ethiodeploy.com/) - Hosting and agentic coding platform containing Built-in Analytics, Database, GitHub CI/CD, free sub-domain, CLI, AI coding agent. Free tier allows one project 256 MB RAM / 0.5 CPU, sleeps after 30 min idle, 512 MB database and 100,000 tokens on the default model one time.

### Issue Tracking and Project Management

*   [Archboard](https://getarchboard.app/) - Architecture diagrams your team and AI agents edit live. Free plan: 1 seat, 3 diagrams, all built-in node packs and live editing with your AI agents (MCP).
*   [UserJot](https://userjot.com) - Live chat, feedback boards, a roadmap, and a changelog, so everything your customers say reaches the people and agents building your product. Free plan: Unlimited Posts, Unlimited Users, 3 Admin Roles, 2 Feedback Boards, Roadmap, Changelog.

### Analytics, Events and Statistics

*   [Datasense](https://usedatasense.com/) - Web analytics with JavaScript error tracking, goals, and revenue attribution. Free plan: 1 site, 5,000 events per month.
*   [Pug](https://pug.sh) - Open-source product analytics with autocapture, trends, funnels, retention, user flows and unified user profiles. Free plan includes 100,000 events per month and 1 year of data retention.

### Payment and Billing Integration

*   [Canjean](https://canjean.com/exchange-rate-api) - Free exchange rate API for 150+ currencies in JSON, CSV and plain text, no API key or sign-up.
*   [UsageRail](https://usagerail.com/) - API keys, rate limits, quotas and usage-based billing for paid APIs, checked inside your own server with no gateway. Free up to $1,000/month billed and 1M requests/month.

### Screenshot APIs

*   [Shotlane](https://shotlane.dev) - Screenshots, clean Markdown and PDFs of any web page, rendered in current Chrome. Hide cookie banners, ads and other popups and many more options. A free account gives you 100 credits per month, no card required.

items.title: Awesome Zsh Plugins
items.content_text:
### ZSH Tools / [superconsole](https://github.com/alexchmykhalo/superconsole) - Windows-only

*   [speedrunner (⭐3)](https://github.com/anthonyGosme/speedrunner) - Speeds up the start of Python, Ruby, PHP and Node CLIs by forking them from a preloaded daemon. Its ZSH hook starts the daemon while you type the command name.

### Plugins / [superconsole](https://github.com/alexchmykhalo/superconsole) - Windows-only

*   [claude-guard (⭐0)](https://github.com/jokerlin/claude-guard) - checks your egress IP before [Claude Code](https://docs.anthropic.com/en/docs/claude-code) starts. If the IP that claude.ai sees is not on your allowlist, claude stops and asks before it connects.
*   [fasd (⭐112)](https://github.com/whjvenyl/fasd) - A command-line productivity booster. Fasd offers quick access to files and directories for POSIX shells. It is inspired by tools like [autojump (⭐17k)](https://github.com/joelthelion/autojump), [z (⭐17k)](http://github.com/rupa/z) and [v (⭐459)](https://github.com/rupa/v). Fasd keeps track of files and directories you have accessed, so that you can quickly reference them in the command line.
*   [oops (⭐2)](https://github.com/ysb3996-blip/oops) - Copies the last command and its output to the clipboard as a Markdown code block, with API keys and other secrets masked. Needs Ruby 3.3 or later; no gem install.
*   [sprout (⭐1)](https://github.com/beenjii14/sprout) - Turn a Jira ticket into a clean `git` branch.
    One command. A short, descriptive name. Zero copy-pasting.
*   [walh-shell (⭐2)](https://github.com/casonadams/walh-shell) - A fast, modern, and extensible Zsh (and Bash) plugin for instant terminal color theme switching that lets you instantly change your terminal’s color scheme with a single command.

items.title: Awesome Gemini Cli
items.content_text:
### Agent Orchestration & CLI Tools

*   [Joxo](https://joxo.ai?utm_source=awesome-gemini-cli\&utm_medium=referral) - Shared project for a team's coding agents. Start Gemini CLI with `joxo gemini` and it works from the same task board, decisions and handoffs as teammates' Claude Code, Codex or Cursor agents, and can ask a teammate's agent for help. Desktop app, iPhone app and a remote MCP server.
*   [EndoStack (⭐4)](https://github.com/requie/endostack) - Security-first workflows for coding agents: 62 skills that threat-model changes, security-review diffs and verify results by running them. Works in Gemini CLI, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and 11 other agents. MIT.
*   [Preloop (⭐85)](https://github.com/preloop/preloop) - Open-source AI agent control plane and software factory: every tool and model call allowed, denied or held for a human, budgeted and recorded, and agents run from tickets, webhooks and CI in hosted containers or on your own runners, landing work as pull requests. Works with Gemini CLI, Claude Code, Codex CLI, Cursor, OpenCode and Copilot CLI. Apache-2.0.
*   [AgentVera](https://agentvera.dev/en/?utm_source=awesome-gemini-cli\&utm_medium=referral) - Desktop app for macOS, Windows and Linux that runs Gemini CLI side by side with Claude Code, Codex, Copilot, Cursor and 13 more coding agents per project, each in a real terminal using your own Gemini CLI install and login. A team kanban board hands cards to agents, and an MCP manager is built in. Closed source; free plan, Pro $9.99/month.
*   [pando (⭐7)](https://github.com/xseman/pando) - Terminal workspace that runs Gemini CLI side by side with Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and shells, each session in its own git worktree, under a daemon that keeps them running when the TUI closes. Marks a Gemini session running or waiting for approval, reviews and commits its diff in the TUI, and has a CLI that blocks on session status.

### Commands & Extensions

*   [vidbyte-memory (⭐2)](https://github.com/cerredz/vidbyte-memory) - Gemini CLI extension and GitHub template for correction-driven memory: corrections become facts Gemini loads, pytest tests where a check can be written, and git commits, and the installer adds an `AfterAgent` hook that sends Gemini back to work (up to 5 times in a row) while tests fail.
*   [Ponder (⭐3)](https://github.com/Quinnod345/ponder) - Gemini CLI extension and Agent Skill for multi-pass deliberation and code review: grades every file or document across 6 dimensions, runs four adversarial perspectives (skeptic, builder, dreamer, empath), and blocks early stopping until coverage reaches 1.00 and churn converges below 0.02 across two consecutive passes. Zero runtime dependencies, MIT. Install with `gemini extensions install https://github.com/Quinnod345/ponder` or `npx skills add Quinnod345/ponder -y -a gemini-cli`.
*   [Log10x (⭐2)](https://github.com/log-10x/log10x-plugin) - Gemini CLI extension that installs the log10x MCP server (MIT, local stdio). It ranks log patterns by volume and cost and plans an action for the excess over each cap: compact on Splunk and self-managed Elasticsearch, tier down or offload to S3 on other platforms. No log data reaches log10x. Install with `gemini extensions install https://github.com/log-10x/log10x-plugin`.
*   [Chisle (⭐743)](https://github.com/JayPokale/Chisle) - Gemini CLI extension whose `GEMINI.md` makes answers shorter without dropping decisive facts: no filler or hedging, the smallest code that works (reuse, stdlib and installed dependencies before new code), and reading less (grep before opening files, sliced reads). Benchmarks with raw transcripts are in the repo. `npx chisle mcp wrap` also trims oversized MCP tool output in Gemini CLI. Install with `gemini extensions install https://github.com/JayPokale/Chisle`. MIT.
*   [Hermoso (⭐5)](https://github.com/hermoso-ai/hermoso) - Gemini CLI extension for marketing: research competitors' ads in the Meta, Google and LinkedIn ad libraries, generate image, video and UGC avatar ads, post and schedule to your own social channels, and manage Meta Ads, Google Ads and TikTok Ads campaigns, through skills that drive the `hermoso` CLI. Install: `gemini extensions install https://github.com/hermoso-ai/hermoso`.

### Development Tools & Utilities

*   [Railse (⭐2)](https://github.com/xufei547/railse-opc) - Self-hosted approval inbox for Gemini CLI, Claude Code and Codex: hooks route every tool call through risk-based rules; for Gemini CLI that means deny rules plus phone notifications for questions and completion, with approvals from the phone for Claude Code and Codex.
*   [Skim (⭐16)](https://github.com/skim-md/skim) - Browser extension that renders the Markdown plans and docs Gemini CLI writes, re-rendering live as the file changes. KaTeX, Mermaid, folder view.

### Education & Study Tools

*   [mock-interview (⭐2)](https://github.com/georgesmomo/mock-interview) - Agent Skill that runs in Gemini CLI and other agents (`npx skills add georgesmomo/mock-interview`). Runs a realistic mock job interview for any role, with research on the job and real follow-up questions, then gives an honest score out of 10 and a written report.

### MCP Servers

*   [JobsPipe](https://jobspipe.dev/mcp-server?utm_source=awesome-gemini-cli\&utm_medium=referral) - Hosted MCP server and Gemini CLI extension for live job postings from 30+ ATS feeds and job boards in one normalized schema: search by role, place, date, salary, seniority, skills and visa stance, read a posting in full, and save searches as alerts. OAuth sign-in or API key, free plan. `gemini extensions install https://github.com/jobspipe/mcp`.
*   [mach-gtm-mcp (⭐1)](https://github.com/verma6uc/mach-gtm-mcp) - Open-source MCP server with five outbound sales helpers for B2B teams: build an ICP, draft a cold email or LinkedIn message from a buying signal you provide, get a prospect research checklist, score a lead 0-100 against your ICP, and lay out a multi-touch sequence. Template-based; it looks nothing up and sends nothing. Works with Gemini CLI and any MCP client. Install: `npx -y github:verma6uc/mach-gtm-mcp`.
*   [Keenable (⭐2)](https://github.com/keenableai/keenable-antigravity) - Web search and page fetch as clean Markdown from Keenable, a search engine with its own crawler and index built for AI agents. Gemini CLI extension that adds Keenable's hosted MCP server (`search_web_pages`, `fetch_page_content`) and a web-lookup skill; keyless, no signup or API key (rate limited per IP). MIT. Install: `gemini extensions install https://github.com/keenableai/keenable-antigravity`.
*   [repofit (⭐4)](https://github.com/pth2002/repofit) - MCP server and CLI that reads what local coding agents already keep (Gemini CLI chats and `GEMINI.md`, plus Codex, Claude Code, Cursor and others) and recommends GitHub projects for the tasks you repeat, each pick citing the session it came from. Also lists installed MCP servers and skills that no session ever called. Runs locally and uses the agent's own model, so no API key. MIT. Add with `gemini mcp add repofit uvx repofit mcp`.
*   [AlphaOSINT LinkedIn Company](https://alphaosint.com/sources/linkedin-company-api/) - Remote MCP server for Gemini CLI that returns a company's LinkedIn page details (size, industry, locations, specialties) through `https://mcp.apify.com/?tools=johnvc/linkedin-company-api`.
*   [Candor Finance](https://candor.money/?utm_source=awesome-gemini-cli\&utm_medium=referral) - Personal finance for Gemini CLI from your own US bank, card, loan, and investment accounts: spending, cash flow, a budget, and goals with a target, a date, and a monthly amount, saved across sessions, plus a weekly review that tells Gemini what is worth talking through. Bank access is read-only and no tool moves money. Hosted MCP server with OAuth sign-in plus 10 agent skills; requires a Candor account. Install: `gemini extensions install https://github.com/candorsystems/candor-finance`, then `/mcp auth candor`.

Agent Orchestration & CLI Tools

  • Joxo - Shared project for a team's coding agents. Start Gemini CLI with joxo gemini and it works from the same task board, decisions and handoffs as teammates' Claude Code, Codex or Cursor agents, and can ask a teammate's agent for help. Desktop app, iPhone app and a remote MCP server.
  • EndoStack (⭐4) - Security-first workflows for coding agents: 62 skills that threat-model changes, security-review diffs and verify results by running them. Works in Gemini CLI, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and 11 other agents. MIT.
  • Preloop (⭐85) - Open-source AI agent control plane and software factory: every tool and model call allowed, denied or held for a human, budgeted and recorded, and agents run from tickets, webhooks and CI in hosted containers or on your own runners, landing work as pull requests. Works with Gemini CLI, Claude Code, Codex CLI, Cursor, OpenCode and Copilot CLI. Apache-2.0.
  • AgentVera - Desktop app for macOS, Windows and Linux that runs Gemini CLI side by side with Claude Code, Codex, Copilot, Cursor and 13 more coding agents per project, each in a real terminal using your own Gemini CLI install and login. A team kanban board hands cards to agents, and an MCP manager is built in. Closed source; free plan, Pro $9.99/month.
  • pando (⭐7) - Terminal workspace that runs Gemini CLI side by side with Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and shells, each session in its own git worktree, under a daemon that keeps them running when the TUI closes. Marks a Gemini session running or waiting for approval, reviews and commits its diff in the TUI, and has a CLI that blocks on session status.

Commands & Extensions

  • vidbyte-memory (⭐2) - Gemini CLI extension and GitHub template for correction-driven memory: corrections become facts Gemini loads, pytest tests where a check can be written, and git commits, and the installer adds an AfterAgent hook that sends Gemini back to work (up to 5 times in a row) while tests fail.
  • Ponder (⭐3) - Gemini CLI extension and Agent Skill for multi-pass deliberation and code review: grades every file or document across 6 dimensions, runs four adversarial perspectives (skeptic, builder, dreamer, empath), and blocks early stopping until coverage reaches 1.00 and churn converges below 0.02 across two consecutive passes. Zero runtime dependencies, MIT. Install with gemini extensions install https://github.com/Quinnod345/ponder or npx skills add Quinnod345/ponder -y -a gemini-cli.
  • Log10x (⭐2) - Gemini CLI extension that installs the log10x MCP server (MIT, local stdio). It ranks log patterns by volume and cost and plans an action for the excess over each cap: compact on Splunk and self-managed Elasticsearch, tier down or offload to S3 on other platforms. No log data reaches log10x. Install with gemini extensions install https://github.com/log-10x/log10x-plugin.
  • Chisle (⭐743) - Gemini CLI extension whose GEMINI.md makes answers shorter without dropping decisive facts: no filler or hedging, the smallest code that works (reuse, stdlib and installed dependencies before new code), and reading less (grep before opening files, sliced reads). Benchmarks with raw transcripts are in the repo. npx chisle mcp wrap also trims oversized MCP tool output in Gemini CLI. Install with gemini extensions install https://github.com/JayPokale/Chisle. MIT.
  • Hermoso (⭐5) - Gemini CLI extension for marketing: research competitors' ads in the Meta, Google and LinkedIn ad libraries, generate image, video and UGC avatar ads, post and schedule to your own social channels, and manage Meta Ads, Google Ads and TikTok Ads campaigns, through skills that drive the hermoso CLI. Install: gemini extensions install https://github.com/hermoso-ai/hermoso.

Development Tools & Utilities

  • Railse (⭐2) - Self-hosted approval inbox for Gemini CLI, Claude Code and Codex: hooks route every tool call through risk-based rules; for Gemini CLI that means deny rules plus phone notifications for questions and completion, with approvals from the phone for Claude Code and Codex.
  • Skim (⭐16) - Browser extension that renders the Markdown plans and docs Gemini CLI writes, re-rendering live as the file changes. KaTeX, Mermaid, folder view.

Education & Study Tools

  • mock-interview (⭐2) - Agent Skill that runs in Gemini CLI and other agents (npx skills add georgesmomo/mock-interview). Runs a realistic mock job interview for any role, with research on the job and real follow-up questions, then gives an honest score out of 10 and a written report.

MCP Servers

  • JobsPipe - Hosted MCP server and Gemini CLI extension for live job postings from 30+ ATS feeds and job boards in one normalized schema: search by role, place, date, salary, seniority, skills and visa stance, read a posting in full, and save searches as alerts. OAuth sign-in or API key, free plan. gemini extensions install https://github.com/jobspipe/mcp.
  • mach-gtm-mcp (⭐1) - Open-source MCP server with five outbound sales helpers for B2B teams: build an ICP, draft a cold email or LinkedIn message from a buying signal you provide, get a prospect research checklist, score a lead 0-100 against your ICP, and lay out a multi-touch sequence. Template-based; it looks nothing up and sends nothing. Works with Gemini CLI and any MCP client. Install: npx -y github:verma6uc/mach-gtm-mcp.
  • Keenable (⭐2) - Web search and page fetch as clean Markdown from Keenable, a search engine with its own crawler and index built for AI agents. Gemini CLI extension that adds Keenable's hosted MCP server (search_web_pages, fetch_page_content) and a web-lookup skill; keyless, no signup or API key (rate limited per IP). MIT. Install: gemini extensions install https://github.com/keenableai/keenable-antigravity.
  • repofit (⭐4) - MCP server and CLI that reads what local coding agents already keep (Gemini CLI chats and GEMINI.md, plus Codex, Claude Code, Cursor and others) and recommends GitHub projects for the tasks you repeat, each pick citing the session it came from. Also lists installed MCP servers and skills that no session ever called. Runs locally and uses the agent's own model, so no API key. MIT. Add with gemini mcp add repofit uvx repofit mcp.
  • AlphaOSINT LinkedIn Company - Remote MCP server for Gemini CLI that returns a company's LinkedIn page details (size, industry, locations, specialties) through https://mcp.apify.com/?tools=johnvc/linkedin-company-api.
  • Candor Finance - Personal finance for Gemini CLI from your own US bank, card, loan, and investment accounts: spending, cash flow, a budget, and goals with a target, a date, and a monthly amount, saved across sessions, plus a weekly review that tells Gemini what is worth talking through. Bank access is read-only and no tool moves money. Hosted MCP server with OAuth sign-in plus 10 agent skills; requires a Candor account. Install: gemini extensions install https://github.com/candorsystems/candor-finance, then /mcp auth candor.
